assets.prompt:
Create one carefully aligned 4 column by 4 row contact sheet of separate children picture-book illustrations. Warm painted style, gentle expressive faces, complete anatomically correct subjects. EXACTLY equal-sized square cells, clean white gutters. Keep all scene content comfortably inside its own cell with 8 percent empty margins, never overlap cells. No labels, no captions, no letters, no watermark; numbers only when specifically requested. Every cell is independent; ordered left to right then top to bottom. No extra rows or thumbnail strips. Each cell should tell its own story. Scenes:
1. Person sits staring blankly with unfocused open eyes, slack mouth and slumped shoulders; quiet muted room; emotionally vacant expression
2. Two coherent vignettes: boy accidentally tears friend drawing; boy apologetically offers newly redrawn picture and crayons; all people fully visible
3. Adult operates machine using control panel, rotating gears in protected casing; small secondary scene adult drives car with steering wheel
4. Fire rescue team quickly turns a small emergency vehicle toward a newly reported incident, responder points direction and team moves promptly; no injuries
5. Three complete vignettes showing liquid pouring from jug into glass, juice into cup, oil into pan; full containers inside tile
6. At dinner child politely gestures for a smaller portion while adult serves too much; smiling tactful request shown by pictorial bubble with smaller bowl
7. Child spins a bucket carousel gently; lightweight hanging ribbons spread outward away from central pole; clear center and outward directions
8. Child tries to bring very large teddy bear through small bedroom doorway, bear visibly larger than usual toys
9. Child measures a teddy bear height using measuring tape to choose fitting gift box; several boxes different sizes
10. Shopkeeper greatly reduces toy price; two price cards show only 1000 and 500 with downward arrow; family reacts happily
11. Community park open to many residents: children, adults and elderly together using shared playground and paths
12. Child arrives home with backpack; parent warmly welcomes at open front door
13. Child extends empty rice bowl toward adult who adds another helping from rice pot
14. Child deliberately places a book flat on a table, hand just releasing book
15. Gray-haired university professor in lecture room explains plants to attentive students; blackboard leaf drawing and botanical book; professor speaking
16. Parent firmly explains a broken toy to child and has child clean up mess as consequence; no hitting, calm serious expressions

Row 2, column 2: A small arched stone bridge over a narrow stream.
Row 2, column 3: A natural spring where clear water bubbles out between rocks into a small pool.
Row 2, column 4: An outdoor produce market stall with vegetable baskets and fruit crates, no signs or words.
Row 3, column 1: A rocky shore with many large gray rocks, only a little blue water behind them.
Row 3, column 2: A sandy seaside beach where gentle blue waves meet the shore.
Row 3, column 3: A fully visible playground overhead monkey-bar ladder supported by four poles.
Row 3, column 4: A railway station platform beside a stopped passenger train, tracks visible, no text.
Row 4, column 1: A Japanese house wooden engawa veranda, narrow raised wooden walkway outside sliding doors.

assets.prompt: Create a STRICT 2 by 2 grid contact sheet of four equal SQUARE tiles with straight pure white gutters at exact halfway boundaries. Warm Japanese childrens picture-book watercolor, anatomically correct, no captions, no words, no titles, no watermarks. Keep all subjects and objects well inside each tile, at least 12 percent safe margin. Tiles in reading order: Tile 1: Two clear side-by-side panels WITHIN ONE square tile. Left a child accidentally tears a friends drawing, with all torn pieces fully visible on a table and sad faces. Right the child provides the friend a new complete drawing, making up for the damage; happy relieved faces and the ENTIRE replacement sheet including all four corners clearly inside the tile. No picture or paper touches any tile edge. Wide safe margin. Tile 2: Three small connected real-life views WITHIN ONE square tile: water flows from a fully visible small jug into a fully visible glass; orange juice pours from a fully visible small carton into another fully visible glass; oil pours from a fully visible small bottle into a fully visible shallow pan. ALL containers and pan entirely inside this tile with generous margin; visible fluid streams show flowing liquids, no neighboring picture fragments, no text. Tile 3 and tile 4: an unused small green leaf centered on white.

previousProvenance.prompt:
Create precisely aligned 3 by 3 contact sheet of NINE independent square Japanese children's educational watercolor illustrations. EXACT equal cells with white narrow gutters at one-third and two-thirds horizontally and vertically. Generous margin inside cells, complete unclipped subjects, clean anatomy, no text, no labels. Row-major:
1 two-part story inside cell: child accidentally tears friend's picture and looks sorry; then spends effort repairing damaged picture with paper and colors, friend happy, making up for damage, no money.
2 recognizable WATER in glass being poured, ORANGE JUICE pouring from carton into glass, and COOKING OIL golden liquid being poured from bottle into pan, all together, liquid everyday examples, no oil barrels or unsafe gasoline handling.
3 two sequential calendar pages LEFT earlier sunny date marked planned sports day and RIGHT later rainy planned date shifted even later; prominent red arrow LEFT to RIGHT from earlier date to later date within same calendar, arrowhead ends at later date, simple dates 10 and 17 if needed.
4 child gently declines another helping of vegetables by politely gesturing a SMALL serving with hands and gentle apologetic face instead of blunt rejection; parent understands, tactful indirect wording illustrated by tiny-serving thought bubble and remaining full plate.
5 diagram on plain white background: central dot, three red arrows starting near dot and radiating straight OUTWARD, arrowheads at outer ends; no circular arrows, NO text, illustrates direction away from center not forces.
6 extension cord connecting wall socket to table lamp far away, clear cable and connected plug/socket fully visible, unplugged shorter cable shown beside for comparison, safe no exposed wire.
7 many children at school festival, varied friendly faces with normal eyes, all entirely within cell, single crowd scene, no stray bottom fragments.
8 before and after shop display for one apple: LEFT price 100 coins represented as ten stacks of ten dots; RIGHT price only 50 coins represented as five stacks of ten dots, large downward arrow and apple in both views, clearly large decrease in price. use concise 100 and 50 numerals if needed.
9 close view two children warmly smiling with natural symmetrical pupils, gentle cute appearance, cheerful happy expressions, no strange eyes, clean simple background.

Wall outlet on LEFT holds plug of white extension cord, cord runs along floor to a FEMALE SOCKET BOX near lamp on RIGHT, LAMP'S OWN PLUG inserted into that female socket box, lamp's own cable rises from box to lamp, lamp lit. Both connecting plugs and box clearly visible, safe dry scene, no spare disconnected cords, no direct wall-to-lamp cable. Connected extension junction prominently centered.

previousProvenance.prompt:
Create precisely aligned 3 by 3 contact sheet of NINE independent square Japanese children's educational watercolor illustrations. EXACT equal cells with white narrow gutters at one-third and two-thirds horizontally and vertically. Generous margin inside cells, complete unclipped subjects, clean anatomy, no text, no labels. Row-major:
1 two-part story inside cell: child accidentally tears friend's picture and looks sorry; then spends effort repairing damaged picture with paper and colors, friend happy, making up for damage, no money.
2 recognizable WATER in glass being poured, ORANGE JUICE pouring from carton into glass, and COOKING OIL golden liquid being poured from bottle into pan, all together, liquid everyday examples, no oil barrels or unsafe gasoline handling.
3 two sequential calendar pages LEFT earlier sunny date marked planned sports day and RIGHT later rainy planned date shifted even later; prominent red arrow LEFT to RIGHT from earlier date to later date within same calendar, arrowhead ends at later date, simple dates 10 and 17 if needed.
4 child gently declines another helping of vegetables by politely gesturing a SMALL serving with hands and gentle apologetic face instead of blunt rejection; parent understands, tactful indirect wording illustrated by tiny-serving thought bubble and remaining full plate.
5 diagram on plain white background: central dot, three red arrows starting near dot and radiating straight OUTWARD, arrowheads at outer ends; no circular arrows, NO text, illustrates direction away from center not forces.
6 extension cord connecting wall socket to table lamp far away, clear cable and connected plug/socket fully visible, unplugged shorter cable shown beside for comparison, safe no exposed wire.
7 many children at school festival, varied friendly faces with normal eyes, all entirely within cell, single crowd scene, no stray bottom fragments.
8 before and after shop display for one apple: LEFT price 100 coins represented as ten stacks of ten dots; RIGHT price only 50 coins represented as five stacks of ten dots, large downward arrow and apple in both views, clearly large decrease in price. use concise 100 and 50 numerals if needed.
9 close view two children warmly smiling with natural symmetrical pupils, gentle cute appearance, cheerful happy expressions, no strange eyes, clean simple background.

previousProvenance.prompt:
Create precisely aligned 3 by 3 contact sheet of NINE independent square Japanese children's educational watercolor illustrations. EXACT equal cells with white narrow gutters at one-third and two-thirds horizontally and vertically. Generous margin inside cells, complete unclipped subjects, clean anatomy, no text, no labels. Row-major:
1 two-part story inside cell: child accidentally tears friend's picture and looks sorry; then spends effort repairing damaged picture with paper and colors, friend happy, making up for damage, no money.
2 recognizable WATER in glass being poured, ORANGE JUICE pouring from carton into glass, and COOKING OIL golden liquid being poured from bottle into pan, all together, liquid everyday examples, no oil barrels or unsafe gasoline handling.
3 two sequential calendar pages LEFT earlier sunny date marked planned sports day and RIGHT later rainy planned date shifted even later; prominent red arrow LEFT to RIGHT from earlier date to later date within same calendar, arrowhead ends at later date, simple dates 10 and 17 if needed.
4 child gently declines another helping of vegetables by politely gesturing a SMALL serving with hands and gentle apologetic face instead of blunt rejection; parent understands, tactful indirect wording illustrated by tiny-serving thought bubble and remaining full plate.
5 diagram on plain white background: central dot, three red arrows starting near dot and radiating straight OUTWARD, arrowheads at outer ends; no circular arrows, NO text, illustrates direction away from center not forces.
6 extension cord connecting wall socket to table lamp far away, clear cable and connected plug/socket fully visible, unplugged shorter cable shown beside for comparison, safe no exposed wire.
7 many children at school festival, varied friendly faces with normal eyes, all entirely within cell, single crowd scene, no stray bottom fragments.
8 before and after shop display for one apple: LEFT price 100 coins represented as ten stacks of ten dots; RIGHT price only 50 coins represented as five stacks of ten dots, large downward arrow and apple in both views, clearly large decrease in price. use concise 100 and 50 numerals if needed.
9 close view two children warmly smiling with natural symmetrical pupils, gentle cute appearance, cheerful happy expressions, no strange eyes, clean simple background.

Create an EXACT 2x2 contact sheet of FOUR equal square independent educational children's watercolor images, centered fully inside each cell, narrow white gutter at exact center axes, generous outer margins. Row-major:

Both arrows point right on the page but because faces are positioned oppositely blue goes INTO face while orange goes AWAY FROM face. Arrowheads must be visible. Second child's pursed lips actively blowing outward. No arrows pointing toward mouth in second panel. No text.
TOP RIGHT: postponing a school sports day because rain. Two calendar pages left October 10 with gray rainy sky and cancelled sports field, right October 17 with sunshine and sports day taking place. Big RED ARROW from LEFT earlier 10 to RIGHT later 17. Numerals 10 and 17 only. Rain MUST be LEFT, sunshine MUST be RIGHT.
BOTTOM LEFT: close clear scene of EXTENSION CORD in use to reach distant table lamp. Wall outlet on LEFT holds plug of white extension cord, cord runs along floor to a FEMALE SOCKET BOX near lamp on RIGHT, LAMP'S OWN PLUG inserted into that female socket box, lamp's own cable rises from box to lamp, lamp lit. Both connecting plugs and box clearly visible, safe dry scene, no spare disconnected cords, no direct wall-to-lamp cable. Connected extension junction prominently centered.
BOTTOM RIGHT: coarse grinding coffee beans. A hand coffee grinder with recognizable handle above, whole brown beans at top, coarse visibly uneven brown coffee pieces in open bottom tray, large beans and coarse grounds clearly discernible, grinding not merely sorting. No text.

assets.prompt:
Create ONE square 4 by 4 contact sheet, EXACTLY 16 equally sized square illustrations, white straight narrow gutters. Row-major order, four columns and four rows. Warm clear Japanese elementary-school picture-book watercolor style. Every cell is independent and fits entirely inside its square with margin. No captions, titles, numbering or watermarks. Follow each cell scene literally, especially action direction and objects.
Cell 1 (row 1, column 1), 鼻歌: A smiling child softly HUMS while tidying books. Lips are CLOSED, cheeks relaxed, a few soft music-note symbols near the closed mouth. No microphone or wide-open singing mouth. Gentle humming.
Cell 2 (row 1, column 2), 甘塩: A small grilled salmon fillet and a tiny pinch of salt between fingers. Only three tiny grains sprinkled lightly, with a happy child tasting the mild salted fish. NO pile of salt or heap of crystals. Mild and lightly salted food.
Cell 3 (row 1, column 3), 洗いざらい: A child empties every single toy block from a box onto a table. The box is tilted and visibly completely empty. All blocks are now on the table, none left inside. Meaning everything without leaving anything out. NO washing or laundry.
Cell 4 (row 1, column 4), 居座り: A stubborn fully clothed adult remains sitting on a chair with arms folded and feet firmly planted. A host stands beside the open exit door and gestures kindly for the adult to leave; seated adult clearly refuses to move. No comfortable napping.
Cell 5 (row 2, column 1), 一石二鳥: One central action: planting one fruit tree. Two clear result bubbles linked from that one tree: on the left, a basket of apples harvested; on the right, a family resting in its cool shade. One effort produces TWO good benefits. No stone or birds.
Cell 6 (row 2, column 2), 鰻登り: A shop owner is amazed by a sales chart rising very steeply from low left to high right, with coin stacks that rise steeply in the same direction. Shows rapid steep growth. NO eel or waterfall.
Cell 7 (row 2, column 3), オウンゴール: A soccer defender in a BLUE jersey accidentally kicks the ball backward into the goal guarded by their own BLUE-jersey goalkeeper. Both BLUE teammates look dismayed. An opposing RED-jersey player outside the goal celebrates. Clear ball arrow leads from BLUE defender to own goal. No mixed teammate colors.
Cell 8 (row 2, column 4), 行政: A municipal city-hall public-service counter. A civil servant processes a resident's application and hands back an official certificate. Small thought bubbles show public garbage collection and repaired streetlights, representing everyday government services implementing rules. NO parliament debate or legislature building.
Cell 9 (row 3, column 1), 献血: A calm fully clothed ADULT volunteer donates blood at a medical donation center. Nurse assists the arm. Tubing from the covered adult forearm runs DOWN to a collection bag resting on a small scale BELOW the arm, on a low trolley. NO hanging IV bag above the arm, no transfusion flowing into the person, no wound or exposed needle or visible puncture. The collected red liquid stays only inside the sealed bag and tubing.
Cell 10 (row 3, column 2), 後退: Side view of a car pointing RIGHT (headlights and hood on the right, rear tail lights on the left). A big arrow under the car points LEFT, showing reversing backward opposite the car's forward direction. Driver looks back over shoulder. Keep hood/rear and arrow unambiguous.
Cell 11 (row 3, column 3), 後転: A backward gym roll in three small stages within one cell, on a soft mat, same person facing LEFT at start and at end. Stage left: crouching, facing left, feet flat and knees tucked. Middle: rolling BACK toward the RIGHT over a rounded back with knees tucked, feet travel over the head to the right, hands beside ears. Right: finishes crouched facing LEFT again. Never change facing direction. A curved arrow points from start to finish to the RIGHT.
Cell 12 (row 3, column 4), しりとり: Japanese shiritori word chain represented by exactly FOUR clear picture icons in order, with arrows: RED APPLE (りんご) → GORILLA (ごりら) → TRUMPET (らっぱ) → PANDA (ぱんだ). Two happy children point at the pictures. The Japanese words correctly connect GO, RA, PA. No writing is necessary; picture identities must be obvious. No monkey, orange, or deer.
Cell 13 (row 4, column 1), 血みどろ: A WHITE torn shirt lying by itself on a chair, mostly covered in RED blood stains. No body wearing it, no wounds or hurt person. A first-aid kit is nearby and a calm fully clothed adult folds a clean replacement white shirt. Non-graphic symbolic aftermath. Clearly white fabric with red stains, never a plain red shirt.
Cell 14 (row 4, column 2), 偽物: Compare a real red apple cut open with real seeds and juicy pale fruit, and a lookalike FAKE plastic red apple that has popped apart into two hollow red shells with a visible seam. A child is surprised by the plastic apple. The fake has no flesh or seeds. No two stuffed toys or identical real apples.
Cell 15 (row 4, column 3), 濡れ手に粟: Fictional metaphor: a relaxed ADULT lightly presses just ONE small button with ONE fingertip. The automatic device instantly delivers a huge pile of gold coins into a basket. Two visual emphases: tiny effort and very large reward. No gambling, no stealing, no grain, no wet hands. Illustrates making large profits with little effort.
Cell 16 (row 4, column 4), 根強い: Lasting popularity over generations: an elderly grandfather shows a sepia photograph of himself as a young boy happily playing KENDAMA, while his smiling young grandchild beside him plays the SAME traditional kendama now. Longtime affection for the same toy. One photo in the background, present people large in foreground. No tree or literal roots.

assets.prompt:
Create a square educational illustration contact sheet. EXACTLY 4 columns by 4 rows, 16 equal square cells, arranged as a precise regular grid across the entire canvas. Each cell is a separate picture. Thin white dividers at exactly 25%, 50%, 75% horizontally and vertically. Soft warm watercolor children's picture-book illustrations, clear simple silhouettes, gentle colors, cream-white background in every cell. Keep every subject completely inside its cell, centered with generous empty margins; no overlap across cells; no cropped subjects. No letters, numbers, titles, labels, logos or watermarks anywhere. Small contextual backgrounds only where requested. Render each scene exactly, in this left-to-right then top-to-bottom order:
Row 1, column 1: Colorful individually wrapped hard candies and one unwrapped round sweet.
Row 1, column 2: A prickly green chestnut burr split open to reveal brown chestnuts.
Row 1, column 3: Three rectangular yellow sweet potato yokan sweets on a small plate.
Row 1, column 4: Soft yellow scrambled eggs on a simple plate.
Row 2, column 1: A bowl of thick white udon noodles in light broth, chopsticks resting beside it.
Row 2, column 2: Three wrinkled reddish Japanese pickled ume plums on a small white plate.
Row 2, column 3: Green edamame soybean pods, one opened to show its green beans.
Row 2, column 4: Chocolate pieces and golden cookies arranged as a small snack.
Row 3, column 1: A bowl of soft rice porridge, visible pale grains in thick creamy liquid.
Row 3, column 2: A plate with several pieces of nigiri sushi, slices of fish on small oblong rice mounds.
Row 3, column 3: Three plain round white rice-flour dumplings on a wooden skewer, on a plate.
Row 3, column 4: Two triangular rice balls with black nori seaweed strips.
Row 4, column 1: A small bowl of boiled spinach in light dashi broth, neatly bundled greens.
Row 4, column 2: An open Japanese lunch box with rice, cooked vegetables and small omelet pieces.
Row 4, column 3: A glass dessert bowl piled with shaved ice and red strawberry syrup, a spoon beside it.
Row 4, column 4: A pink-and-white semicircular fish cake loaf on its wooden board, with three sliced pieces.

assets.prompt:

Each cell is a separate picture. Thin white dividers at exactly 25%, 50%, 75% horizontally and vertically. Keep every subject completely inside its cell, centered with generous empty margins; no overlap across cells; no cropped subjects. No letters, numbers, titles, labels, logos or watermarks anywhere. Small contextual backgrounds only where requested. Render each scene exactly, in this left-to-right then top-to-bottom order:

Row 1, column 2: A prickly green chestnut burr split open to reveal brown chestnuts.
Row 1, column 3: Three rectangular yellow sweet potato yokan sweets on a small plate.
Row 1, column 4: Soft yellow scrambled eggs on a simple plate.
Row 2, column 1: A bowl of thick white udon noodles in light broth, chopsticks resting beside it.
Row 2, column 2: Three wrinkled reddish Japanese pickled ume plums on a small white plate.
Row 2, column 3: Green edamame soybean pods, one opened to show its green beans.
Row 2, column 4: Chocolate pieces and golden cookies arranged as a small snack.
Row 3, column 1: A bowl of soft rice porridge, visible pale grains in thick creamy liquid.
Row 3, column 2: A plate with several pieces of nigiri sushi, slices of fish on small oblong rice mounds.
Row 3, column 3: Three plain round white rice-flour dumplings on a wooden skewer, on a plate.
Row 3, column 4: Two triangular rice balls with black nori seaweed strips.
Row 4, column 1: A small bowl of boiled spinach in light dashi broth, neatly bundled greens.
Row 4, column 2: An open Japanese lunch box with rice, cooked vegetables and small omelet pieces.
Row 4, column 3: A glass dessert bowl piled with shaved ice and red strawberry syrup, a spoon beside it.

assets.prompt:
Create a STRICT 4 by 4 grid contact sheet of 16 equally sized SQUARE tiles, row-major order. Warm Japanese childrens picture-book watercolor and clear line art, consistent gentle realistic anatomy. Each tile independent. Keep ALL content well within each tile with 7 percent margin on every edge. Pure white straight gutters at exact quarter boundaries. No tile numbers, captions, titles, borders, watermarks or extra panels. No words except explicitly requested in a tile. No bleed across tiles. Every main face and object complete.
Tile 1 (row 1, column 1): Two children measure the height and width of a cardboard box with a tape measure before choosing a box that fits a shelf. Clearly show measuring dimensions in a real packing scene.
Tile 2 (row 1, column 2): A spirited GIRL with pigtails wearing shorts energetically climbs low playground climbing bars; cheerful active pose and playful muddy knees, a parent watches safely nearby. No boy as main subject.
Tile 3 (row 1, column 3): Two toy robots clean the same floor. A shiny robot moves quickly and has finished its neat clean area; a battered older robot crawls slowly with a visibly unfinished area, loose panel and small wobble marks. Compare machine performance, no human humiliation.
Tile 4 (row 1, column 4): A child opens a gift and is visibly startled: eyes very wide, eyebrows lifted high, mouth open in a round O, torso recoils, both hands lifted. A harmless toy springs from the gift, strong surprised expression, no smile.
Tile 5 (row 2, column 1): A hungry child waits at a dining table with an EMPTY plate, clutching the stomach, furrowed brows, drooping shoulders and unhappy strained mouth. Cooking pot in the distant kitchen is not yet ready. No food in front of child, no delighted expression.
Tile 6 (row 2, column 2): A child sits upright IN BED in pajamas, suddenly realizing they overslept. Shocked worried face looks at an alarm clock showing late morning, bright sun through window, school bag by bed. Not a child arriving at school.
Tile 7 (row 2, column 3): Three children at one art table each work on their own distinct drawing with their own crayons; one draws flowers, one a boat, one a cat. Each individual acts separately in a shared believable scene.
Tile 8 (row 2, column 4): A parent tells a story aloud to two children seated nearby; mouth visibly speaking, friendly listening faces, a speech bubble shows a simple fairy-tale castle. No letters, envelopes, cards or written communication.
Tile 9 (row 3, column 1): A child struggling in shallow water has a worried strained expression, splashes, and reaches for help; an adult on stable bank firmly pulls the child to safety by hand while another holds a flotation ring close. Clearly distress plus ongoing rescue, no injury, no submerged face or shocking danger.
Tile 10 (row 3, column 2): A shop counter with a large main chocolate bar and its wrapper; a tiny inexpensive plastic toy car in a separate little transparent bonus packet attached to the chocolate package. Child delighted by the small extra toy, chocolate visibly main purchase.
Tile 11 (row 3, column 3): A girl steps DOWN from a stationary bus onto a pavement, one foot firmly on sidewalk, the other on the lower bus step; handrail held, whole body and correctly formed feet visible. Bus door and steps coherent.
Tile 12 (row 3, column 4): A sunny farm with flourishing vegetables, a gentle irrigation stream and family enjoying the harvest. Sunlight, water and fertile soil visibly bring benefit; emphasize gifts of nature, not a person handing a gift.
Tile 13 (row 4, column 1): A clever child solves how to cross a puddle without wet feet: places several stable stepping stones and tests the path carefully while a friend watches admiringly. Clear planning and good judgment, no adult cleaning a mess.
Tile 14 (row 4, column 2): Close view of a child biting directly into a large whole red apple, front teeth visibly meeting apple skin; apple much larger than one mouthful, small fresh bite mark. Not eating with a spoon.
Tile 15 (row 4, column 3): A child counts six apples one by one, index finger touching the next apple while the other hand records tally marks on paper. All apples and counting person visible, no abstract row of dots.
Tile 16 (row 4, column 4): A child opens a lunch box expecting lunch but finds it completely empty, looks puzzled and tips lid open toward viewer; companion starts offering a sandwich. Show an empty container as part of a story, not a labeled diagram.

Tile 1 (row 1, column 1): Two children measure the height and width of a cardboard box with a tape measure before choosing a box that fits a shelf. Clearly show measuring dimensions in a real packing scene.
Tile 2 (row 1, column 2): A spirited GIRL with pigtails wearing shorts energetically climbs low playground climbing bars; cheerful active pose and playful muddy knees, a parent watches safely nearby. No boy as main subject.
Tile 3 (row 1, column 3): Two toy robots clean the same floor. A shiny robot moves quickly and has finished its neat clean area; a battered older robot crawls slowly with a visibly unfinished area, loose panel and small wobble marks. Compare machine performance, no human humiliation.
Tile 4 (row 1, column 4): A child opens a gift and is visibly startled: eyes very wide, eyebrows lifted high, mouth open in a round O, torso recoils, both hands lifted. A harmless toy springs from the gift, strong surprised expression, no smile.
Tile 5 (row 2, column 1): A hungry child waits at a dining table with an EMPTY plate, clutching the stomach, furrowed brows, drooping shoulders and unhappy strained mouth. Cooking pot in the distant kitchen is not yet ready. No food in front of child, no delighted expression.
Tile 6 (row 2, column 2): A child sits upright IN BED in pajamas, suddenly realizing they overslept. Shocked worried face looks at an alarm clock showing late morning, bright sun through window, school bag by bed. Not a child arriving at school.
Tile 7 (row 2, column 3): Three children at one art table each work on their own distinct drawing with their own crayons; one draws flowers, one a boat, one a cat. Each individual acts separately in a shared believable scene.
Tile 8 (row 2, column 4): A parent tells a story aloud to two children seated nearby; mouth visibly speaking, friendly listening faces, a speech bubble shows a simple fairy-tale castle. No letters, envelopes, cards or written communication.
Tile 9 (row 3, column 1): A child struggling in shallow water has a worried strained expression, splashes, and reaches for help; an adult on stable bank firmly pulls the child to safety by hand while another holds a flotation ring close. Clearly distress plus ongoing rescue, no injury, no submerged face or shocking danger.
Tile 10 (row 3, column 2): A shop counter with a large main chocolate bar and its wrapper; a tiny inexpensive plastic toy car in a separate little transparent bonus packet attached to the chocolate package. Child delighted by the small extra toy, chocolate visibly main purchase.
Tile 11 (row 3, column 3): A girl steps DOWN from a stationary bus onto a pavement, one foot firmly on sidewalk, the other on the lower bus step; handrail held, whole body and correctly formed feet visible. Bus door and steps coherent.
Tile 12 (row 3, column 4): A sunny farm with flourishing vegetables, a gentle irrigation stream and family enjoying the harvest. Sunlight, water and fertile soil visibly bring benefit; emphasize gifts of nature, not a person handing a gift.
Tile 13 (row 4, column 1): A clever child solves how to cross a puddle without wet feet: places several stable stepping stones and tests the path carefully while a friend watches admiringly. Clear planning and good judgment, no adult cleaning a mess.
Tile 14 (row 4, column 2): Close view of a child biting directly into a large whole red apple, front teeth visibly meeting apple skin; apple much larger than one mouthful, small fresh bite mark. Not eating with a spoon.
Tile 15 (row 4, column 3): A child counts six apples one by one, index finger touching the next apple while the other hand records tally marks on paper. All apples and counting person visible, no abstract row of dots.
Tile 16 (row 4, column 4): A child opens a lunch box expecting lunch but finds it completely empty, looks puzzled and tips lid open toward viewer; companion starts offering a sandwich. Show an empty container as part of a story, not a labeled diagram.

assets.prompt:
Create a STRICT 4 by 4 grid contact sheet of 16 equally sized SQUARE tiles, row-major order. Warm Japanese childrens picture-book watercolor and clear line art, consistent gentle realistic anatomy. Each tile independent. Keep ALL content well within each tile with 7 percent margin on every edge. Pure white straight gutters at exact quarter boundaries. No tile numbers, captions, titles, borders, watermarks or extra panels. No words except explicitly requested in a tile. No bleed across tiles. Every main face and object complete.
Tile 1 (row 1, column 1): Two children measure the height and width of a cardboard box with a tape measure before choosing a box that fits a shelf. Clearly show measuring dimensions in a real packing scene.
Tile 2 (row 1, column 2): A spirited GIRL with pigtails wearing shorts energetically climbs low playground climbing bars; cheerful active pose and playful muddy knees, a parent watches safely nearby. No boy as main subject.
Tile 3 (row 1, column 3): Two toy robots clean the same floor. A shiny robot moves quickly and has finished its neat clean area; a battered older robot crawls slowly with a visibly unfinished area, loose panel and small wobble marks. Compare machine performance, no human humiliation.
Tile 4 (row 1, column 4): A child opens a gift and is visibly startled: eyes very wide, eyebrows lifted high, mouth open in a round O, torso recoils, both hands lifted. A harmless toy springs from the gift, strong surprised expression, no smile.
Tile 5 (row 2, column 1): A hungry child waits at a dining table with an EMPTY plate, clutching the stomach, furrowed brows, drooping shoulders and unhappy strained mouth. Cooking pot in the distant kitchen is not yet ready. No food in front of child, no delighted expression.
Tile 6 (row 2, column 2): A child sits upright IN BED in pajamas, suddenly realizing they overslept. Shocked worried face looks at an alarm clock showing late morning, bright sun through window, school bag by bed. Not a child arriving at school.
Tile 7 (row 2, column 3): Three children at one art table each work on their own distinct drawing with their own crayons; one draws flowers, one a boat, one a cat. Each individual acts separately in a shared believable scene.
Tile 8 (row 2, column 4): A parent tells a story aloud to two children seated nearby; mouth visibly speaking, friendly listening faces, a speech bubble shows a simple fairy-tale castle. No letters, envelopes, cards or written communication.
Tile 9 (row 3, column 1): A child struggling in shallow water has a worried strained expression, splashes, and reaches for help; an adult on stable bank firmly pulls the child to safety by hand while another holds a flotation ring close. Clearly distress plus ongoing rescue, no injury, no submerged face or shocking danger.
Tile 10 (row 3, column 2): A shop counter with a large main chocolate bar and its wrapper; a tiny inexpensive plastic toy car in a separate little transparent bonus packet attached to the chocolate package. Child delighted by the small extra toy, chocolate visibly main purchase.
Tile 11 (row 3, column 3): A girl steps DOWN from a stationary bus onto a pavement, one foot firmly on sidewalk, the other on the lower bus step; handrail held, whole body and correctly formed feet visible. Bus door and steps coherent.
Tile 12 (row 3, column 4): A sunny farm with flourishing vegetables, a gentle irrigation stream and family enjoying the harvest. Sunlight, water and fertile soil visibly bring benefit; emphasize gifts of nature, not a person handing a gift.
Tile 13 (row 4, column 1): A clever child solves how to cross a puddle without wet feet: places several stable stepping stones and tests the path carefully while a friend watches admiringly. Clear planning and good judgment, no adult cleaning a mess.
Tile 14 (row 4, column 2): Close view of a child biting directly into a large whole red apple, front teeth visibly meeting apple skin; apple much larger than one mouthful, small fresh bite mark. Not eating with a spoon.
Tile 15 (row 4, column 3): A child counts six apples one by one, index finger touching the next apple while the other hand records tally marks on paper. All apples and counting person visible, no abstract row of dots.
Tile 16 (row 4, column 4): A child opens a lunch box expecting lunch but finds it completely empty, looks puzzled and tips lid open toward viewer; companion starts offering a sandwich. Show an empty container as part of a story, not a labeled diagram.

assets.prompt:
Create a square contact sheet with exactly SIXTEEN distinct equally sized illustrations in a precise uniform 4 by 4 grid. Reading order left to right top to bottom. All objects wholly inside their cell with ample margin, thin white gutters. Warm clean children's educational picture-book watercolor, gentle outlines, simple pale backgrounds, biologically accurate animals and plants, no human faces on animals, no text labels numbers logos watermarks. Scenes:
1. A modest house with windows, front door and small garden.
2. An anatomically accurate squid swimming underwater, elongated mantle, two fins, eight short arms and TWO extra long feeding tentacles distinguishable.
3. A wooden raft made from logs tied together floating on water.
4. A friendly dog sitting, realistic animal proportions.
5. Ripe red strawberries with leafy green caps.
6. Whole and cut sweet potatoes with soil clinging to skins.
7. A large natural boulder with a child-sized tree for scale.
8. A dairy cow standing in a pasture, natural udder.
9. A horse standing in a field.
10. A wide blue ocean reaching the horizon with gentle waves.
11. A plum tree branch blooming early spring with five-petal round pink flowers.
12. A whole fuzzy peach and a cut half showing single pit.
13. A simple metal door key with bow and teeth.
14. Orange persimmon fruits with green leafy calyx.
15. A realistic brown pond frog beside water, long bent hind legs.
16. A realistic red crab with two claws and eight walking legs.

assets.prompt:
Create a STRICT 4 by 4 grid contact sheet of 16 equally sized SQUARE tiles, row-major order. Warm Japanese childrens picture-book watercolor and clear line art, consistent gentle realistic anatomy. Each tile independent. Keep ALL content well within each tile with 7 percent margin on every edge. Pure white straight gutters at exact quarter boundaries. No tile numbers, captions, titles, borders, watermarks or extra panels. No words except explicitly requested in a tile. No bleed across tiles. Every main face and object complete.
Tile 1 (row 1, column 1): Two children measure the height and width of a cardboard box with a tape measure before choosing a box that fits a shelf. Clearly show measuring dimensions in a real packing scene.
Tile 2 (row 1, column 2): A spirited GIRL with pigtails wearing shorts energetically climbs low playground climbing bars; cheerful active pose and playful muddy knees, a parent watches safely nearby. No boy as main subject.
Tile 3 (row 1, column 3): Two toy robots clean the same floor. A shiny robot moves quickly and has finished its neat clean area; a battered older robot crawls slowly with a visibly unfinished area, loose panel and small wobble marks. Compare machine performance, no human humiliation.
Tile 4 (row 1, column 4): A child opens a gift and is visibly startled: eyes very wide, eyebrows lifted high, mouth open in a round O, torso recoils, both hands lifted. A harmless toy springs from the gift, strong surprised expression, no smile.
Tile 5 (row 2, column 1): A hungry child waits at a dining table with an EMPTY plate, clutching the stomach, furrowed brows, drooping shoulders and unhappy strained mouth. Cooking pot in the distant kitchen is not yet ready. No food in front of child, no delighted expression.
Tile 6 (row 2, column 2): A child sits upright IN BED in pajamas, suddenly realizing they overslept. Shocked worried face looks at an alarm clock showing late morning, bright sun through window, school bag by bed. Not a child arriving at school.
Tile 7 (row 2, column 3): Three children at one art table each work on their own distinct drawing with their own crayons; one draws flowers, one a boat, one a cat. Each individual acts separately in a shared believable scene.
Tile 8 (row 2, column 4): A parent tells a story aloud to two children seated nearby; mouth visibly speaking, friendly listening faces, a speech bubble shows a simple fairy-tale castle. No letters, envelopes, cards or written communication.
Tile 9 (row 3, column 1): A child struggling in shallow water has a worried strained expression, splashes, and reaches for help; an adult on stable bank firmly pulls the child to safety by hand while another holds a flotation ring close. Clearly distress plus ongoing rescue, no injury, no submerged face or shocking danger.
Tile 10 (row 3, column 2): A shop counter with a large main chocolate bar and its wrapper; a tiny inexpensive plastic toy car in a separate little transparent bonus packet attached to the chocolate package. Child delighted by the small extra toy, chocolate visibly main purchase.
Tile 11 (row 3, column 3): A girl steps DOWN from a stationary bus onto a pavement, one foot firmly on sidewalk, the other on the lower bus step; handrail held, whole body and correctly formed feet visible. Bus door and steps coherent.
Tile 12 (row 3, column 4): A sunny farm with flourishing vegetables, a gentle irrigation stream and family enjoying the harvest. Sunlight, water and fertile soil visibly bring benefit; emphasize gifts of nature, not a person handing a gift.
Tile 13 (row 4, column 1): A clever child solves how to cross a puddle without wet feet: places several stable stepping stones and tests the path carefully while a friend watches admiringly. Clear planning and good judgment, no adult cleaning a mess.
Tile 14 (row 4, column 2): Close view of a child biting directly into a large whole red apple, front teeth visibly meeting apple skin; apple much larger than one mouthful, small fresh bite mark. Not eating with a spoon.
Tile 15 (row 4, column 3): A child counts six apples one by one, index finger touching the next apple while the other hand records tally marks on paper. All apples and counting person visible, no abstract row of dots.
Tile 16 (row 4, column 4): A child opens a lunch box expecting lunch but finds it completely empty, looks puzzled and tips lid open toward viewer; companion starts offering a sandwich. Show an empty container as part of a story, not a labeled diagram.

assets.prompt:

Each tile independent. Keep ALL content well within each tile with 7 percent margin on every edge. Pure white straight gutters at exact quarter boundaries. No tile numbers, captions, titles, borders, watermarks or extra panels. No words except explicitly requested in a tile. No bleed across tiles. Every main face and object complete.
Tile 1 (row 1, column 1): Two children measure the height and width of a cardboard box with a tape measure before choosing a box that fits a shelf. Clearly show measuring dimensions in a real packing scene.
Tile 2 (row 1, column 2): A spirited GIRL with pigtails wearing shorts energetically climbs low playground climbing bars; cheerful active pose and playful muddy knees, a parent watches safely nearby. No boy as main subject.
Tile 3 (row 1, column 3): Two toy robots clean the same floor. A shiny robot moves quickly and has finished its neat clean area; a battered older robot crawls slowly with a visibly unfinished area, loose panel and small wobble marks. Compare machine performance, no human humiliation.
Tile 4 (row 1, column 4): A child opens a gift and is visibly startled: eyes very wide, eyebrows lifted high, mouth open in a round O, torso recoils, both hands lifted. A harmless toy springs from the gift, strong surprised expression, no smile.
Tile 5 (row 2, column 1): A hungry child waits at a dining table with an EMPTY plate, clutching the stomach, furrowed brows, drooping shoulders and unhappy strained mouth. Cooking pot in the distant kitchen is not yet ready. No food in front of child, no delighted expression.
Tile 6 (row 2, column 2): A child sits upright IN BED in pajamas, suddenly realizing they overslept. Shocked worried face looks at an alarm clock showing late morning, bright sun through window, school bag by bed. Not a child arriving at school.
Tile 7 (row 2, column 3): Three children at one art table each work on their own distinct drawing with their own crayons; one draws flowers, one a boat, one a cat. Each individual acts separately in a shared believable scene.
Tile 8 (row 2, column 4): A parent tells a story aloud to two children seated nearby; mouth visibly speaking, friendly listening faces, a speech bubble shows a simple fairy-tale castle. No letters, envelopes, cards or written communication.
Tile 9 (row 3, column 1): A child struggling in shallow water has a worried strained expression, splashes, and reaches for help; an adult on stable bank firmly pulls the child to safety by hand while another holds a flotation ring close. Clearly distress plus ongoing rescue, no injury, no submerged face or shocking danger.
Tile 10 (row 3, column 2): A shop counter with a large main chocolate bar and its wrapper; a tiny inexpensive plastic toy car in a separate little transparent bonus packet attached to the chocolate package. Child delighted by the small extra toy, chocolate visibly main purchase.
Tile 11 (row 3, column 3): A girl steps DOWN from a stationary bus onto a pavement, one foot firmly on sidewalk, the other on the lower bus step; handrail held, whole body and correctly formed feet visible. Bus door and steps coherent.
Tile 12 (row 3, column 4): A sunny farm with flourishing vegetables, a gentle irrigation stream and family enjoying the harvest. Sunlight, water and fertile soil visibly bring benefit; emphasize gifts of nature, not a person handing a gift.
Tile 13 (row 4, column 1): A clever child solves how to cross a puddle without wet feet: places several stable stepping stones and tests the path carefully while a friend watches admiringly. Clear planning and good judgment, no adult cleaning a mess.
Tile 14 (row 4, column 2): Close view of a child biting directly into a large whole red apple, front teeth visibly meeting apple skin; apple much larger than one mouthful, small fresh bite mark. Not eating with a spoon.
Tile 15 (row 4, column 3): A child counts six apples one by one, index finger touching the next apple while the other hand records tally marks on paper. All apples and counting person visible, no abstract row of dots.
Tile 16 (row 4, column 4): A child opens a lunch box expecting lunch but finds it completely empty, looks puzzled and tips lid open toward viewer; companion starts offering a sandwich. Show an empty container as part of a story, not a labeled diagram.

No tile numbers, captions, titles, borders, watermarks or extra panels. No words except explicitly requested in a tile. No bleed across tiles. Every main face and object complete.
Tile 1 (row 1, column 1): Two children measure the height and width of a cardboard box with a tape measure before choosing a box that fits a shelf. Clearly show measuring dimensions in a real packing scene.
Tile 2 (row 1, column 2): A spirited GIRL with pigtails wearing shorts energetically climbs low playground climbing bars; cheerful active pose and playful muddy knees, a parent watches safely nearby. No boy as main subject.
Tile 3 (row 1, column 3): Two toy robots clean the same floor. A shiny robot moves quickly and has finished its neat clean area; a battered older robot crawls slowly with a visibly unfinished area, loose panel and small wobble marks. Compare machine performance, no human humiliation.
Tile 4 (row 1, column 4): A child opens a gift and is visibly startled: eyes very wide, eyebrows lifted high, mouth open in a round O, torso recoils, both hands lifted. A harmless toy springs from the gift, strong surprised expression, no smile.
Tile 5 (row 2, column 1): A hungry child waits at a dining table with an EMPTY plate, clutching the stomach, furrowed brows, drooping shoulders and unhappy strained mouth. Cooking pot in the distant kitchen is not yet ready. No food in front of child, no delighted expression.
Tile 6 (row 2, column 2): A child sits upright IN BED in pajamas, suddenly realizing they overslept. Shocked worried face looks at an alarm clock showing late morning, bright sun through window, school bag by bed. Not a child arriving at school.
Tile 7 (row 2, column 3): Three children at one art table each work on their own distinct drawing with their own crayons; one draws flowers, one a boat, one a cat. Each individual acts separately in a shared believable scene.
Tile 8 (row 2, column 4): A parent tells a story aloud to two children seated nearby; mouth visibly speaking, friendly listening faces, a speech bubble shows a simple fairy-tale castle. No letters, envelopes, cards or written communication.
Tile 9 (row 3, column 1): A child struggling in shallow water has a worried strained expression, splashes, and reaches for help; an adult on stable bank firmly pulls the child to safety by hand while another holds a flotation ring close. Clearly distress plus ongoing rescue, no injury, no submerged face or shocking danger.
Tile 10 (row 3, column 2): A shop counter with a large main chocolate bar and its wrapper; a tiny inexpensive plastic toy car in a separate little transparent bonus packet attached to the chocolate package. Child delighted by the small extra toy, chocolate visibly main purchase.
Tile 11 (row 3, column 3): A girl steps DOWN from a stationary bus onto a pavement, one foot firmly on sidewalk, the other on the lower bus step; handrail held, whole body and correctly formed feet visible. Bus door and steps coherent.
Tile 12 (row 3, column 4): A sunny farm with flourishing vegetables, a gentle irrigation stream and family enjoying the harvest. Sunlight, water and fertile soil visibly bring benefit; emphasize gifts of nature, not a person handing a gift.
Tile 13 (row 4, column 1): A clever child solves how to cross a puddle without wet feet: places several stable stepping stones and tests the path carefully while a friend watches admiringly. Clear planning and good judgment, no adult cleaning a mess.
Tile 14 (row 4, column 2): Close view of a child biting directly into a large whole red apple, front teeth visibly meeting apple skin; apple much larger than one mouthful, small fresh bite mark. Not eating with a spoon.
Tile 15 (row 4, column 3): A child counts six apples one by one, index finger touching the next apple while the other hand records tally marks on paper. All apples and counting person visible, no abstract row of dots.
Tile 16 (row 4, column 4): A child opens a lunch box expecting lunch but finds it completely empty, looks puzzled and tips lid open toward viewer; companion starts offering a sandwich. Show an empty container as part of a story, not a labeled diagram.

assets.prompt:
Create one precisely aligned 4 by 4 contact sheet of SIXTEEN independent square children's vocabulary illustrations. EXACT equal cells, white narrow gutters at 25%,50%,75% horizontally and vertically, generous blank margin within every cell, entire subjects centered, no adjacent image fragments. Warm Japanese children's book watercolor, readable small, anatomically plausible. No labels, no letters, no captions except exact tiny measurement numbers expressly requested. Row-major:
1 child running fast toward school gate, body leaning forward, flying backpack straps and sweat, worried urgent expression, speed marks.
2 another child urging a slow walking friend onward, pointing urgently toward gate and clock with worried face, friend accelerates, clear haste prompted by person.
3 child very energetic jumping cheerfully, exemplary VERY energetic, no second scene below.
4 two-panel young musician working very hard rehearsing then overwhelmed with joy receiving recognition, highest point of happiness, culmination.
5 child drinks glass of water in one continuous go, no alcohol, glass tilted naturally.
6 EXACTLY TWO children cooperate carrying one large box together, same direction synchronized movement, one simple heart above connected teamwork.
7 ruler centimeter ticks measures a wooden segment approximately THREE CENTIMETERS, start 0 and end 3 cm, clear accurately proportioned centimeter ticks, fingers hold ruler steady; only small accurate 0 1 2 3 markings if possible.
8 child offered broccoli, recoils, brows knitted, nose wrinkled, mouth grimacing, palms pushing away, unmistakable dislike and refusal, no smile.
9 child about to walk outside in heavy rain, notices they have no umbrella, parent hands needed umbrella; clear practical need.
10 printer outputs paper with rows of dark PRINTED CHARACTERS only, no photographs or colored scenery, ordinary document, printed page prominent.
11 child secretly conceals broken vase pieces in a box behind back while another asks about empty pedestal, ashamed evasive expression, deliberate concealment.
12 thin white sheet viewed nearly edge-on with hand and arrow pointing directly to extremely thin paper edge, thicker book beside for contrast.
13 child denies breaking vase with a thought/speech bubble depicting vase still whole, while visible broken vase and ball at child's feet reveal truth; clear lie versus reality.
14 daytime living room, child lightly dozing seated on sofa with open book in lap, sunlight through window, clothes on, no bed, no moon.
15 child searching carefully for hidden toy on shelf, narrowed focused eyes and scanning hand shading eyes, no leftover scene below.
16 child safely sitting astride big cylindrical gym cushion on mat, legs one on each side, straddling pose clearly, no actual horse.

assets.prompt:
Create a STRICT 4 by 4 grid contact sheet of 16 equally sized SQUARE tiles, row-major order. Warm Japanese childrens picture-book watercolor and clear line art, consistent gentle realistic anatomy. Each tile independent. Keep ALL content well within each tile with 7 percent margin on every edge. Pure white straight gutters at exact quarter boundaries. No tile numbers, captions, titles, borders, watermarks or extra panels. No words except explicitly requested in a tile. No bleed across tiles. Every main face and object complete.
Tile 1 (row 1, column 1): A child tilts a transparent cookie jar upside down after all cookies were eaten; absolutely nothing comes out. Surprised disappointed face, a few crumbs on table, jar clearly empty.
Tile 2 (row 1, column 2): A family moves into a rented small house: landlord gives keys, moving boxes and modest sofa visible, family begins daily life inside. House on loan for living, not a child borrowing stationery.
Tile 3 (row 1, column 3): School event: a temporary reception desk made from a folding table and simple canopy stands in front of a permanent school entrance. Volunteers set it up and stack folding chairs, unmistakably temporary provisional setup.
Tile 4 (row 1, column 4): Fairy-tale princess at a ball under a short-lived magic spell: a clock approaches midnight, sparkling dress begins reverting into plain clothes at the hem and magical carriage fades toward a pumpkin outside. Transient condition, original storybook design, not a branded character.
Tile 5 (row 2, column 1): An adorable small fluffy puppy tilts its head, round gentle eyes, tiny paws, soft ears; a child crouches nearby smiling fondly. Puppy is the main subject.
Tile 6 (row 2, column 2): Five clearly separated vignettes of the same child: sees a colorful flower with eyes; listens to a ringing bell with ear; smells a flower with nose; tastes a strawberry with tongue; touches soft fabric with hand. All five senses explicitly visible, no labels.
Tile 7 (row 2, column 3): Children plant seedlings in a garden bed, using a small ruler to leave equal gaps between the plants. Main action is checking the distance between neighboring seedlings, real garden context.
Tile 8 (row 2, column 4): Two equal narrative halves: left a worker strikes a metal bell repeatedly with a small mallet, clear ringing vibration marks; right an angry child with furrowed brows, tight mouth and fists after a toy breaks. Show metallic ringing sound and intense anger, no text.
Tile 9 (row 3, column 1): Two coherent halves: film director beside camera giving actors instructions on a film set; sports coach beside a soccer field holding tactics clipboard and instructing team. Both directing people, cinema and sports explicitly visible.
Tile 10 (row 3, column 2): A determined adult hiker perseveres through cold rain on a steep rocky uphill trail, shoulders strained under heavy backpack, face tired but resolute. Boots muddy, safe footing, wind and effort clear. Depict hardship, endurance and toughness without injury.
Tile 11 (row 3, column 3): An office worker drafts a formal written proposal at a desk, several typed pages with neat headings and numbered sections, pen revising one page, computer and folder. Business documents are main focus, not models or childrens play.
Tile 12 (row 3, column 4): Two friends plan a camping trip before leaving: study a paper calendar, map and checklist on a desk; a shared thought bubble shows tent and campsite they intend to visit. Plans on paper and in minds, not already building a model.
Tile 13 (row 4, column 1): Three real scenes integrated in one image: air being pumped into a transparent balloon; faint vapor mist above warm kettle, with heat source safe; bubbles of gas rising through sparkling water. Air inside balloon and bubbles are gases; no particle diagram, no solid smoke chunks.
Tile 14 (row 4, column 2): Three distinct competitions in one coherent sports day collage: runners racing, children competing in a chess match, and two groups in a tug-of-war. Clearly broader competition beyond foot racing, friendly rivalry.
Tile 15 (row 4, column 3): Three equally large connected scenes for Japanese civic duties: parent brings school-age child to a school gate (parent ensuring education); adult works in a workshop; adult pays tax at a government counter with a paper form and coins. No implying schoolchild has duty to work or pay taxes.
Tile 16 (row 4, column 4): A child opens a wooden matryoshka nesting doll into two halves, revealing its clearly hollow interior; smaller nesting doll sits beside it on table. Show actual inner cavity, not rectangular diagram.

assets.prompt:
Create a STRICT 4 by 4 grid contact sheet of 16 equally sized SQUARE tiles, row-major order. Warm Japanese childrens picture-book watercolor and clear line art, consistent gentle realistic anatomy. Each tile independent. Keep ALL content well within each tile with 7 percent margin on every edge. Pure white straight gutters at exact quarter boundaries. No tile numbers, captions, titles, borders, watermarks or extra panels. No words except explicitly requested in a tile. No bleed across tiles. Every main face and object complete.
Tile 1 (row 1, column 1): A child tilts a transparent cookie jar upside down after all cookies were eaten; absolutely nothing comes out. Surprised disappointed face, a few crumbs on table, jar clearly empty.
Tile 2 (row 1, column 2): A family moves into a rented small house: landlord gives keys, moving boxes and modest sofa visible, family begins daily life inside. House on loan for living, not a child borrowing stationery.
Tile 3 (row 1, column 3): School event: a temporary reception desk made from a folding table and simple canopy stands in front of a permanent school entrance. Volunteers set it up and stack folding chairs, unmistakably temporary provisional setup.
Tile 4 (row 1, column 4): Fairy-tale princess at a ball under a short-lived magic spell: a clock approaches midnight, sparkling dress begins reverting into plain clothes at the hem and magical carriage fades toward a pumpkin outside. Transient condition, original storybook design, not a branded character.
Tile 5 (row 2, column 1): An adorable small fluffy puppy tilts its head, round gentle eyes, tiny paws, soft ears; a child crouches nearby smiling fondly. Puppy is the main subject.
Tile 6 (row 2, column 2): Five clearly separated vignettes of the same child: sees a colorful flower with eyes; listens to a ringing bell with ear; smells a flower with nose; tastes a strawberry with tongue; touches soft fabric with hand. All five senses explicitly visible, no labels.
Tile 7 (row 2, column 3): Children plant seedlings in a garden bed, using a small ruler to leave equal gaps between the plants. Main action is checking the distance between neighboring seedlings, real garden context.
Tile 8 (row 2, column 4): Two equal narrative halves: left a worker strikes a metal bell repeatedly with a small mallet, clear ringing vibration marks; right an angry child with furrowed brows, tight mouth and fists after a toy breaks. Show metallic ringing sound and intense anger, no text.
Tile 9 (row 3, column 1): Two coherent halves: film director beside camera giving actors instructions on a film set; sports coach beside a soccer field holding tactics clipboard and instructing team. Both directing people, cinema and sports explicitly visible.
Tile 10 (row 3, column 2): A determined adult hiker perseveres through cold rain on a steep rocky uphill trail, shoulders strained under heavy backpack, face tired but resolute. Boots muddy, safe footing, wind and effort clear. Depict hardship, endurance and toughness without injury.
Tile 11 (row 3, column 3): An office worker drafts a formal written proposal at a desk, several typed pages with neat headings and numbered sections, pen revising one page, computer and folder. Business documents are main focus, not models or childrens play.
Tile 12 (row 3, column 4): Two friends plan a camping trip before leaving: study a paper calendar, map and checklist on a desk; a shared thought bubble shows tent and campsite they intend to visit. Plans on paper and in minds, not already building a model.
Tile 13 (row 4, column 1): Three real scenes integrated in one image: air being pumped into a transparent balloon; faint vapor mist above warm kettle, with heat source safe; bubbles of gas rising through sparkling water. Air inside balloon and bubbles are gases; no particle diagram, no solid smoke chunks.
Tile 14 (row 4, column 2): Three distinct competitions in one coherent sports day collage: runners racing, children competing in a chess match, and two groups in a tug-of-war. Clearly broader competition beyond foot racing, friendly rivalry.
Tile 15 (row 4, column 3): Three equally large connected scenes for Japanese civic duties: parent brings school-age child to a school gate (parent ensuring education); adult works in a workshop; adult pays tax at a government counter with a paper form and coins. No implying schoolchild has duty to work or pay taxes.
Tile 16 (row 4, column 4): A child opens a wooden matryoshka nesting doll into two halves, revealing its clearly hollow interior; smaller nesting doll sits beside it on table. Show actual inner cavity, not rectangular diagram.

assets.prompt:
Create a STRICT 4 by 4 grid contact sheet of 16 equally sized SQUARE tiles, row-major order. Warm Japanese childrens picture-book watercolor and clear line art, consistent gentle realistic anatomy. Each tile independent. Keep ALL content well within each tile with 7 percent margin on every edge. Pure white straight gutters at exact quarter boundaries. No tile numbers, captions, titles, borders, watermarks or extra panels. No words except explicitly requested in a tile. No bleed across tiles. Every main face and object complete.
Tile 1 (row 1, column 1): A child tilts a transparent cookie jar upside down after all cookies were eaten; absolutely nothing comes out. Surprised disappointed face, a few crumbs on table, jar clearly empty.
Tile 2 (row 1, column 2): A family moves into a rented small house: landlord gives keys, moving boxes and modest sofa visible, family begins daily life inside. House on loan for living, not a child borrowing stationery.
Tile 3 (row 1, column 3): School event: a temporary reception desk made from a folding table and simple canopy stands in front of a permanent school entrance. Volunteers set it up and stack folding chairs, unmistakably temporary provisional setup.
Tile 4 (row 1, column 4): Fairy-tale princess at a ball under a short-lived magic spell: a clock approaches midnight, sparkling dress begins reverting into plain clothes at the hem and magical carriage fades toward a pumpkin outside. Transient condition, original storybook design, not a branded character.
Tile 5 (row 2, column 1): An adorable small fluffy puppy tilts its head, round gentle eyes, tiny paws, soft ears; a child crouches nearby smiling fondly. Puppy is the main subject.
Tile 6 (row 2, column 2): Five clearly separated vignettes of the same child: sees a colorful flower with eyes; listens to a ringing bell with ear; smells a flower with nose; tastes a strawberry with tongue; touches soft fabric with hand. All five senses explicitly visible, no labels.
Tile 7 (row 2, column 3): Children plant seedlings in a garden bed, using a small ruler to leave equal gaps between the plants. Main action is checking the distance between neighboring seedlings, real garden context.
Tile 8 (row 2, column 4): Two equal narrative halves: left a worker strikes a metal bell repeatedly with a small mallet, clear ringing vibration marks; right an angry child with furrowed brows, tight mouth and fists after a toy breaks. Show metallic ringing sound and intense anger, no text.
Tile 9 (row 3, column 1): Two coherent halves: film director beside camera giving actors instructions on a film set; sports coach beside a soccer field holding tactics clipboard and instructing team. Both directing people, cinema and sports explicitly visible.
Tile 10 (row 3, column 2): A determined adult hiker perseveres through cold rain on a steep rocky uphill trail, shoulders strained under heavy backpack, face tired but resolute. Boots muddy, safe footing, wind and effort clear. Depict hardship, endurance and toughness without injury.
Tile 11 (row 3, column 3): An office worker drafts a formal written proposal at a desk, several typed pages with neat headings and numbered sections, pen revising one page, computer and folder. Business documents are main focus, not models or childrens play.
Tile 12 (row 3, column 4): Two friends plan a camping trip before leaving: study a paper calendar, map and checklist on a desk; a shared thought bubble shows tent and campsite they intend to visit. Plans on paper and in minds, not already building a model.
Tile 13 (row 4, column 1): Three real scenes integrated in one image: air being pumped into a transparent balloon; faint vapor mist above warm kettle, with heat source safe; bubbles of gas rising through sparkling water. Air inside balloon and bubbles are gases; no particle diagram, no solid smoke chunks.
Tile 14 (row 4, column 2): Three distinct competitions in one coherent sports day collage: runners racing, children competing in a chess match, and two groups in a tug-of-war. Clearly broader competition beyond foot racing, friendly rivalry.
Tile 15 (row 4, column 3): Three equally large connected scenes for Japanese civic duties: parent brings school-age child to a school gate (parent ensuring education); adult works in a workshop; adult pays tax at a government counter with a paper form and coins. No implying schoolchild has duty to work or pay taxes.
Tile 16 (row 4, column 4): A child opens a wooden matryoshka nesting doll into two halves, revealing its clearly hollow interior; smaller nesting doll sits beside it on table. Show actual inner cavity, not rectangular diagram.

assets.prompt:
Create a STRICT 4 by 4 grid contact sheet of 16 equally sized SQUARE tiles, row-major order. Warm Japanese childrens picture-book watercolor and clear line art, consistent gentle realistic anatomy. Each tile independent. Keep ALL content well within each tile with 7 percent margin on every edge. Pure white straight gutters at exact quarter boundaries. No tile numbers, captions, titles, borders, watermarks or extra panels. No words except explicitly requested in a tile. No bleed across tiles. Every main face and object complete.
Tile 1 (row 1, column 1): A child tilts a transparent cookie jar upside down after all cookies were eaten; absolutely nothing comes out. Surprised disappointed face, a few crumbs on table, jar clearly empty.
Tile 2 (row 1, column 2): A family moves into a rented small house: landlord gives keys, moving boxes and modest sofa visible, family begins daily life inside. House on loan for living, not a child borrowing stationery.
Tile 3 (row 1, column 3): School event: a temporary reception desk made from a folding table and simple canopy stands in front of a permanent school entrance. Volunteers set it up and stack folding chairs, unmistakably temporary provisional setup.
Tile 4 (row 1, column 4): Fairy-tale princess at a ball under a short-lived magic spell: a clock approaches midnight, sparkling dress begins reverting into plain clothes at the hem and magical carriage fades toward a pumpkin outside. Transient condition, original storybook design, not a branded character.
Tile 5 (row 2, column 1): An adorable small fluffy puppy tilts its head, round gentle eyes, tiny paws, soft ears; a child crouches nearby smiling fondly. Puppy is the main subject.
Tile 6 (row 2, column 2): Five clearly separated vignettes of the same child: sees a colorful flower with eyes; listens to a ringing bell with ear; smells a flower with nose; tastes a strawberry with tongue; touches soft fabric with hand. All five senses explicitly visible, no labels.
Tile 7 (row 2, column 3): Children plant seedlings in a garden bed, using a small ruler to leave equal gaps between the plants. Main action is checking the distance between neighboring seedlings, real garden context.
Tile 8 (row 2, column 4): Two equal narrative halves: left a worker strikes a metal bell repeatedly with a small mallet, clear ringing vibration marks; right an angry child with furrowed brows, tight mouth and fists after a toy breaks. Show metallic ringing sound and intense anger, no text.
Tile 9 (row 3, column 1): Two coherent halves: film director beside camera giving actors instructions on a film set; sports coach beside a soccer field holding tactics clipboard and instructing team. Both directing people, cinema and sports explicitly visible.
Tile 10 (row 3, column 2): A determined adult hiker perseveres through cold rain on a steep rocky uphill trail, shoulders strained under heavy backpack, face tired but resolute. Boots muddy, safe footing, wind and effort clear. Depict hardship, endurance and toughness without injury.
Tile 11 (row 3, column 3): An office worker drafts a formal written proposal at a desk, several typed pages with neat headings and numbered sections, pen revising one page, computer and folder. Business documents are main focus, not models or childrens play.
Tile 12 (row 3, column 4): Two friends plan a camping trip before leaving: study a paper calendar, map and checklist on a desk; a shared thought bubble shows tent and campsite they intend to visit. Plans on paper and in minds, not already building a model.
Tile 13 (row 4, column 1): Three real scenes integrated in one image: air being pumped into a transparent balloon; faint vapor mist above warm kettle, with heat source safe; bubbles of gas rising through sparkling water. Air inside balloon and bubbles are gases; no particle diagram, no solid smoke chunks.
Tile 14 (row 4, column 2): Three distinct competitions in one coherent sports day collage: runners racing, children competing in a chess match, and two groups in a tug-of-war. Clearly broader competition beyond foot racing, friendly rivalry.
Tile 15 (row 4, column 3): Three equally large connected scenes for Japanese civic duties: parent brings school-age child to a school gate (parent ensuring education); adult works in a workshop; adult pays tax at a government counter with a paper form and coins. No implying schoolchild has duty to work or pay taxes.
Tile 16 (row 4, column 4): A child opens a wooden matryoshka nesting doll into two halves, revealing its clearly hollow interior; smaller nesting doll sits beside it on table. Show actual inner cavity, not rectangular diagram.

assets.prompt:
Create a STRICT 4 by 4 grid contact sheet of 16 equally sized SQUARE tiles, row-major order. Warm Japanese childrens picture-book watercolor and clear line art, consistent gentle realistic anatomy. Each tile independent. Keep ALL content well within each tile with 7 percent margin on every edge. Pure white straight gutters at exact quarter boundaries. No tile numbers, captions, titles, borders, watermarks or extra panels. No words except explicitly requested in a tile. No bleed across tiles. Every main face and object complete.
Tile 1 (row 1, column 1): A family cuts a whole birthday cake; a child takes only one small slice while the remaining cake is clearly visible. Show a part of a whole through a real scene.
Tile 2 (row 1, column 2): A child opens curtains and marvels at a garden entirely covered by fresh snow, from foreground to horizon; a whole surface blanketed with snow.
Tile 3 (row 1, column 3): Close view of a child holding up exactly one index finger with the other four fingers folded, counting one. Entire hand visible, anatomically correct, not pointing at a distant object.
Tile 4 (row 1, column 4): A child on a bicycle completes one circuit of a circular park path, returning to the same starting bench where a parent waves. Path is visible as one continuous loop in a real park.
Tile 5 (row 2, column 1): A friendly forensic investigator kneels by a footprint in mud and holds a shoe beside it; distinctive zigzag sole exactly matches the muddy impression. Magnifying glass, no crime or distress.
Tile 6 (row 2, column 2): A grandparent and child watch a pendulum clock. Pendulum shown at evenly spaced swing positions with a small unobtrusive arc; steady rhythm at home, no disconnected diagram.
Tile 7 (row 2, column 3): Two clear narrative halves: left a child pulls a sweet-potato vine and several attached tubers emerge successively from soil; right a friendly investigator follows connected clues from one photo to another to solve a harmless mystery. Show literal vine and metaphor of linked discoveries, no words.
Tile 8 (row 2, column 4): A child reluctantly tidies scattered toys after a parent asks. Child IS doing the task, putting a block in a box, shoulders slumped, downturned mouth, unhappy but accepting; no refusal gesture.
Tile 9 (row 3, column 1): A friendly neighborhood inventor repairs a toy and builds a small wind-powered device in a garage. Neighbors point to him with admiring smiles and a shared speech bubble containing the short Japanese nickname「町の発明家」. Explain a common nickname people use, not a formal title; only this exact legible text.
Tile 10 (row 3, column 2): Three connected real-life views: a child marks a meeting spot on a map with a red mark; adult holds a carved name seal; the seal presses red ink onto paper leaving a clear stamp impression. Include physical seal and printed mark, no extra text.
Tile 11 (row 3, column 3): Beautiful outer-space scene of two spherical stars or planets in the same starry sky with soft mutual attraction lines, drifting slightly toward each other; small spaceship observes. Both bodies attract each other. No instructional labels or atom diagram.
Tile 12 (row 3, column 4): A child has just broken a blue vase with a ball. Nearby lies the ball and broken vase. Child points at an innocent seated cat and makes a speech bubble clearly showing that same CAT pushing the same vase, a false claim. Actual cat peaceful, adult skeptical.
Tile 13 (row 4, column 1): A boy repeatedly boasts unbelievable lies to skeptical friends: three speech bubbles show himself flying without wings, lifting a huge elephant, and riding a fish through the sky. Bubbles clearly show the same boy, exaggerated fanciful claims.
Tile 14 (row 4, column 2): A tired adult with an unmistakably vacant hollow expression sits looking into an empty cup: unfocused eyes, drooping posture, no smile, distracted gaze. A visibly empty open box nearby connects literal emptiness and emotional vacancy. Gentle, not frightening.
Tile 15 (row 4, column 3): A rescue crew rapidly changes its plan when a road is blocked by a fallen branch: one member points to an alternative route on a map, another immediately deploys a small nimble rescue vehicle toward the alternate path. Dynamic responsive action, safe scene, no ordinary car-driving lesson.
Tile 16 (row 4, column 4): A child planting trees looks up at an enormous mature tree beside a tiny new sapling. Human scale and natural setting make large height and breadth unmistakable.
