assets.prompt:
Create a STRICT 4 by 4 grid contact sheet of 16 equally sized SQUARE tiles, row-major order. Warm Japanese childrens picture-book watercolor and clear line art, consistent gentle realistic anatomy. Each tile independent. Keep ALL content well within each tile with 7 percent margin on every edge. Pure white straight gutters at exact quarter boundaries. No tile numbers, captions, titles, borders, watermarks or extra panels. No words except explicitly requested in a tile. No bleed across tiles. Every main face and object complete.
Tile 1 (row 1, column 1): A child tilts a transparent cookie jar upside down after all cookies were eaten; absolutely nothing comes out. Surprised disappointed face, a few crumbs on table, jar clearly empty.
Tile 2 (row 1, column 2): A family moves into a rented small house: landlord gives keys, moving boxes and modest sofa visible, family begins daily life inside. House on loan for living, not a child borrowing stationery.
Tile 3 (row 1, column 3): School event: a temporary reception desk made from a folding table and simple canopy stands in front of a permanent school entrance. Volunteers set it up and stack folding chairs, unmistakably temporary provisional setup.
Tile 4 (row 1, column 4): Fairy-tale princess at a ball under a short-lived magic spell: a clock approaches midnight, sparkling dress begins reverting into plain clothes at the hem and magical carriage fades toward a pumpkin outside. Transient condition, original storybook design, not a branded character.
Tile 5 (row 2, column 1): An adorable small fluffy puppy tilts its head, round gentle eyes, tiny paws, soft ears; a child crouches nearby smiling fondly. Puppy is the main subject.
Tile 6 (row 2, column 2): Five clearly separated vignettes of the same child: sees a colorful flower with eyes; listens to a ringing bell with ear; smells a flower with nose; tastes a strawberry with tongue; touches soft fabric with hand. All five senses explicitly visible, no labels.
Tile 7 (row 2, column 3): Children plant seedlings in a garden bed, using a small ruler to leave equal gaps between the plants. Main action is checking the distance between neighboring seedlings, real garden context.
Tile 8 (row 2, column 4): Two equal narrative halves: left a worker strikes a metal bell repeatedly with a small mallet, clear ringing vibration marks; right an angry child with furrowed brows, tight mouth and fists after a toy breaks. Show metallic ringing sound and intense anger, no text.
Tile 9 (row 3, column 1): Two coherent halves: film director beside camera giving actors instructions on a film set; sports coach beside a soccer field holding tactics clipboard and instructing team. Both directing people, cinema and sports explicitly visible.
Tile 10 (row 3, column 2): A determined adult hiker perseveres through cold rain on a steep rocky uphill trail, shoulders strained under heavy backpack, face tired but resolute. Boots muddy, safe footing, wind and effort clear. Depict hardship, endurance and toughness without injury.
Tile 11 (row 3, column 3): An office worker drafts a formal written proposal at a desk, several typed pages with neat headings and numbered sections, pen revising one page, computer and folder. Business documents are main focus, not models or childrens play.
Tile 12 (row 3, column 4): Two friends plan a camping trip before leaving: study a paper calendar, map and checklist on a desk; a shared thought bubble shows tent and campsite they intend to visit. Plans on paper and in minds, not already building a model.
Tile 13 (row 4, column 1): Three real scenes integrated in one image: air being pumped into a transparent balloon; faint vapor mist above warm kettle, with heat source safe; bubbles of gas rising through sparkling water. Air inside balloon and bubbles are gases; no particle diagram, no solid smoke chunks.
Tile 14 (row 4, column 2): Three distinct competitions in one coherent sports day collage: runners racing, children competing in a chess match, and two groups in a tug-of-war. Clearly broader competition beyond foot racing, friendly rivalry.
Tile 15 (row 4, column 3): Three equally large connected scenes for Japanese civic duties: parent brings school-age child to a school gate (parent ensuring education); adult works in a workshop; adult pays tax at a government counter with a paper form and coins. No implying schoolchild has duty to work or pay taxes.
Tile 16 (row 4, column 4): A child opens a wooden matryoshka nesting doll into two halves, revealing its clearly hollow interior; smaller nesting doll sits beside it on table. Show actual inner cavity, not rectangular diagram.

assets.meaning: 首がとても長い、アフリカの大型の動物。
assets.prompt:
Create one square educational watercolor illustration contact sheet, precisely FOUR rows and FOUR columns, exactly 16 equal square cells. Warm gentle Japanese children book watercolor, soft paper texture, simple clear shapes, realistic recognizable objects, cream white backgrounds and generous margins. All subjects completely inside their cells, no clipping, each cell independent. No words, letters, numbers, captions, labels, logos, grid numbers or decorative borders. Thin pale whitespace gutters exactly at quarter boundaries. Read cell order left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Do not combine or skip any subject. 
Row 1, column 1: A giraffe with very long neck and brown patches standing in grass.
Row 1, column 2: A bright orange goldfish swimming in a simple clear round fish bowl.
Row 1, column 3: A sturdy gray metal safe with round combination dial and handle.
Row 1, column 4: Two interlocking metal cogwheels with clearly visible teeth.
Row 2, column 1: A wooden acoustic guitar with six strings and round sound hole.
Row 2, column 2: Several uncooked beef slices on a clean white plate.
Row 2, column 3: A glass of white cow milk beside a plain milk bottle with no label.
Row 2, column 4: Six crescent-shaped pan-fried gyoza dumplings on a white plate.
Row 3, column 1: Three metal nails with flat heads and pointed ends.
Row 3, column 2: A small fresh green clump of soft grassy plants growing from soil.
Row 3, column 3: A short silver chain made of linked oval metal rings.
Row 3, column 4: Several thin plain bamboo skewers with pointed tips.
Row 4, column 1: A large blue whale swimming underwater in side view, entire body visible.
Row 4, column 2: A pair of comfortable red children sneakers with laces.
Row 4, column 3: A pair of striped cotton socks.
Row 4, column 4: A curved wooden shoehorn beside a simple shoe, heel insertion visible.
Make each complete object fit inside its cell with 10 percent blank margin on all sides. No objects touching cell edges.
MANDATORY EMPTY SAFE MARGIN: Every subject including every tip, grass blade and the shoehorn handle MUST fit fully within the central 70 percent width and central 70 percent height of its individual cell. This means visibly large 15 percent blank cream margins on ALL FOUR SIDES. The shoehorn handle top must be far below its cell top edge. Do not let any small part touch a cell edge. Make subjects slightly smaller to ensure padding.

Tile 4 (row 1, column 4): Fairy-tale princess at a ball under a short-lived magic spell: a clock approaches midnight, sparkling dress begins reverting into plain clothes at the hem and magical carriage fades toward a pumpkin outside. Transient condition, original storybook design, not a branded character.
Tile 5 (row 2, column 1): An adorable small fluffy puppy tilts its head, round gentle eyes, tiny paws, soft ears; a child crouches nearby smiling fondly. Puppy is the main subject.
Tile 6 (row 2, column 2): Five clearly separated vignettes of the same child: sees a colorful flower with eyes; listens to a ringing bell with ear; smells a flower with nose; tastes a strawberry with tongue; touches soft fabric with hand. All five senses explicitly visible, no labels.

Tile 8 (row 2, column 4): Two equal narrative halves: left a worker strikes a metal bell repeatedly with a small mallet, clear ringing vibration marks; right an angry child with furrowed brows, tight mouth and fists after a toy breaks. Show metallic ringing sound and intense anger, no text.

assets.prompt:
Create ONE square 4 by 4 contact sheet, EXACTLY 16 equally sized square illustrations, white straight narrow gutters. Row-major order, four columns and four rows. Warm clear Japanese elementary-school picture-book watercolor style. Every cell is independent and fits entirely inside its square with margin. No captions, titles, numbering or watermarks. Follow each cell scene literally, especially action direction and objects.
Cell 1 (row 1, column 1), 鼻歌: A smiling child softly HUMS while tidying books. Lips are CLOSED, cheeks relaxed, a few soft music-note symbols near the closed mouth. No microphone or wide-open singing mouth. Gentle humming.
Cell 2 (row 1, column 2), 甘塩: A small grilled salmon fillet and a tiny pinch of salt between fingers. Only three tiny grains sprinkled lightly, with a happy child tasting the mild salted fish. NO pile of salt or heap of crystals. Mild and lightly salted food.
Cell 3 (row 1, column 3), 洗いざらい: A child empties every single toy block from a box onto a table. The box is tilted and visibly completely empty. All blocks are now on the table, none left inside. Meaning everything without leaving anything out. NO washing or laundry.
Cell 4 (row 1, column 4), 居座り: A stubborn fully clothed adult remains sitting on a chair with arms folded and feet firmly planted. A host stands beside the open exit door and gestures kindly for the adult to leave; seated adult clearly refuses to move. No comfortable napping.
Cell 5 (row 2, column 1), 一石二鳥: One central action: planting one fruit tree. Two clear result bubbles linked from that one tree: on the left, a basket of apples harvested; on the right, a family resting in its cool shade. One effort produces TWO good benefits. No stone or birds.
Cell 6 (row 2, column 2), 鰻登り: A shop owner is amazed by a sales chart rising very steeply from low left to high right, with coin stacks that rise steeply in the same direction. Shows rapid steep growth. NO eel or waterfall.
Cell 7 (row 2, column 3), オウンゴール: A soccer defender in a BLUE jersey accidentally kicks the ball backward into the goal guarded by their own BLUE-jersey goalkeeper. Both BLUE teammates look dismayed. An opposing RED-jersey player outside the goal celebrates. Clear ball arrow leads from BLUE defender to own goal. No mixed teammate colors.
Cell 8 (row 2, column 4), 行政: A municipal city-hall public-service counter. A civil servant processes a resident's application and hands back an official certificate. Small thought bubbles show public garbage collection and repaired streetlights, representing everyday government services implementing rules. NO parliament debate or legislature building.
Cell 9 (row 3, column 1), 献血: A calm fully clothed ADULT volunteer donates blood at a medical donation center. Nurse assists the arm. Tubing from the covered adult forearm runs DOWN to a collection bag resting on a small scale BELOW the arm, on a low trolley. NO hanging IV bag above the arm, no transfusion flowing into the person, no wound or exposed needle or visible puncture. The collected red liquid stays only inside the sealed bag and tubing.
Cell 10 (row 3, column 2), 後退: Side view of a car pointing RIGHT (headlights and hood on the right, rear tail lights on the left). A big arrow under the car points LEFT, showing reversing backward opposite the car's forward direction. Driver looks back over shoulder. Keep hood/rear and arrow unambiguous.
Cell 11 (row 3, column 3), 後転: A backward gym roll in three small stages within one cell, on a soft mat, same person facing LEFT at start and at end. Stage left: crouching, facing left, feet flat and knees tucked. Middle: rolling BACK toward the RIGHT over a rounded back with knees tucked, feet travel over the head to the right, hands beside ears. assets.prompt:
Create a STRICT 4 by 4 grid contact sheet of 16 equally sized SQUARE tiles, row-major order. Warm Japanese childrens picture-book watercolor and clear line art, consistent gentle realistic anatomy. Each tile independent. Keep ALL content well within each tile with 7 percent margin on every edge. Pure white straight gutters at exact quarter boundaries. No tile numbers, captions, titles, borders, watermarks or extra panels. No words except explicitly requested in a tile. No bleed across tiles. Every main face and object complete.
Tile 1 (row 1, column 1): A child tilts a transparent cookie jar upside down after all cookies were eaten; absolutely nothing comes out. Surprised disappointed face, a few crumbs on table, jar clearly empty.
Tile 2 (row 1, column 2): A family moves into a rented small house: landlord gives keys, moving boxes and modest sofa visible, family begins daily life inside. House on loan for living, not a child borrowing stationery.
Tile 3 (row 1, column 3): School event: a temporary reception desk made from a folding table and simple canopy stands in front of a permanent school entrance. Volunteers set it up and stack folding chairs, unmistakably temporary provisional setup.
Tile 4 (row 1, column 4): Fairy-tale princess at a ball under a short-lived magic spell: a clock approaches midnight, sparkling dress begins reverting into plain clothes at the hem and magical carriage fades toward a pumpkin outside. Transient condition, original storybook design, not a branded character.
Tile 5 (row 2, column 1): An adorable small fluffy puppy tilts its head, round gentle eyes, tiny paws, soft ears; a child crouches nearby smiling fondly. Puppy is the main subject.
Tile 6 (row 2, column 2): Five clearly separated vignettes of the same child: sees a colorful flower with eyes; listens to a ringing bell with ear; smells a flower with nose; tastes a strawberry with tongue; touches soft fabric with hand. All five senses explicitly visible, no labels.
Tile 7 (row 2, column 3): Children plant seedlings in a garden bed, using a small ruler to leave equal gaps between the plants. Main action is checking the distance between neighboring seedlings, real garden context.
Tile 8 (row 2, column 4): Two equal narrative halves: left a worker strikes a metal bell repeatedly with a small mallet, clear ringing vibration marks; right an angry child with furrowed brows, tight mouth and fists after a toy breaks. Show metallic ringing sound and intense anger, no text.
Tile 9 (row 3, column 1): Two coherent halves: film director beside camera giving actors instructions on a film set; sports coach beside a soccer field holding tactics clipboard and instructing team. Both directing people, cinema and sports explicitly visible.
Tile 10 (row 3, column 2): A determined adult hiker perseveres through cold rain on a steep rocky uphill trail, shoulders strained under heavy backpack, face tired but resolute. Boots muddy, safe footing, wind and effort clear. Depict hardship, endurance and toughness without injury.
Tile 11 (row 3, column 3): An office worker drafts a formal written proposal at a desk, several typed pages with neat headings and numbered sections, pen revising one page, computer and folder. Business documents are main focus, not models or childrens play.
Tile 12 (row 3, column 4): Two friends plan a camping trip before leaving: study a paper calendar, map and checklist on a desk; a shared thought bubble shows tent and campsite they intend to visit. Plans on paper and in minds, not already building a model.
Tile 13 (row 4, column 1): Three real scenes integrated in one image: air being pumped into a transparent balloon; faint vapor mist above warm kettle, with heat source safe; bubbles of gas rising through sparkling water. Air inside balloon and bubbles are gases; no particle diagram, no solid smoke chunks.
Tile 14 (row 4, column 2): Three distinct competitions in one coherent sports day collage: runners racing, children competing in a chess match, and two groups in a tug-of-war. Clearly broader competition beyond foot racing, friendly rivalry.
Tile 15 (row 4, column 3): Three equally large connected scenes for Japanese civic duties: parent brings school-age child to a school gate (parent ensuring education); adult works in a workshop; adult pays tax at a government counter with a paper form and coins. No implying schoolchild has duty to work or pay taxes.
Tile 16 (row 4, column 4): A child opens a wooden matryoshka nesting doll into two halves, revealing its clearly hollow interior; smaller nesting doll sits beside it on table. Show actual inner cavity, not rectangular diagram.

assets.meaning: 輸血などに使う血液を必要とする人のために血液を提供すること。
assets.prompt:
Create ONE square 4 by 4 contact sheet, EXACTLY 16 equally sized square illustrations, white straight narrow gutters. Row-major order, four columns and four rows. Warm clear Japanese elementary-school picture-book watercolor style. Every cell is independent and fits entirely inside its square with margin. No captions, titles, numbering or watermarks. Follow each cell scene literally, especially action direction and objects.
Cell 1 (row 1, column 1), 鼻歌: A smiling child softly HUMS while tidying books. Lips are CLOSED, cheeks relaxed, a few soft music-note symbols near the closed mouth. No microphone or wide-open singing mouth. Gentle humming.
Cell 2 (row 1, column 2), 甘塩: A small grilled salmon fillet and a tiny pinch of salt between fingers. Only three tiny grains sprinkled lightly, with a happy child tasting the mild salted fish. NO pile of salt or heap of crystals. Mild and lightly salted food.
Cell 3 (row 1, column 3), 洗いざらい: A child empties every single toy block from a box onto a table. The box is tilted and visibly completely empty. All blocks are now on the table, none left inside. Meaning everything without leaving anything out. NO washing or laundry.
Cell 4 (row 1, column 4), 居座り: A stubborn fully clothed adult remains sitting on a chair with arms folded and feet firmly planted. A host stands beside the open exit door and gestures kindly for the adult to leave; seated adult clearly refuses to move. No comfortable napping.
Cell 5 (row 2, column 1), 一石二鳥: One central action: planting one fruit tree. Two clear result bubbles linked from that one tree: on the left, a basket of apples harvested; on the right, a family resting in its cool shade. One effort produces TWO good benefits. No stone or birds.
Cell 6 (row 2, column 2), 鰻登り: A shop owner is amazed by a sales chart rising very steeply from low left to high right, with coin stacks that rise steeply in the same direction. Shows rapid steep growth. NO eel or waterfall.
Cell 7 (row 2, column 3), オウンゴール: A soccer defender in a BLUE jersey accidentally kicks the ball backward into the goal guarded by their own BLUE-jersey goalkeeper. Both BLUE teammates look dismayed. An opposing RED-jersey player outside the goal celebrates. Clear ball arrow leads from BLUE defender to own goal. No mixed teammate colors.

assets.prompt:
Create one carefully aligned 4 column by 4 row contact sheet of separate children picture-book illustrations. Warm painted style, gentle expressive faces, complete anatomically correct subjects. EXACTLY equal-sized square cells, clean white gutters. Keep all scene content comfortably inside its own cell with 8 percent empty margins, never overlap cells. No labels, no captions, no letters, no watermark; numbers only when specifically requested. Every cell is independent; ordered left to right then top to bottom. No extra rows or thumbnail strips. Each cell should tell its own story. Scenes:
1. Child prepares to go out, putting on shoes beside backpack and coat in entryway
2. Energetic young girl with ponytail playfully climbs a sturdy low playground climbing frame; visibly a girl
3. Two toy motorcars tested on same track: old dented car struggling far behind sleek faster car; stopwatch and finish ribbon make lower performance clear
4. Child startled by jack-in-box springing open: wide eyes, raised eyebrows, open round mouth, shoulders lifted
5. Hungry child waits for food holding belly, frowning with discomfort, empty plate on table; no smile
6. Child sitting up in bed realizes overslept, startled worried face, bedside clock shows late morning and sunlight enters; bedding clear
7. Three children each work on their own different craft at shared table: one paints, one folds paper, one builds blocks
8. Grandparent orally tells a story to children gathered on sofa; mouth speaking and expressive gestures; story bubble shows a friendly dragon, no letter
9. Lifeguard extends rescue ring to child struggling in water: child eyes worried, mouth open gasping, arms holding ring; helper close and safety assured; gentle no graphic distress
10. Chocolate box opened with clearly visible chocolates as main product and small inexpensive plastic toy car included as bonus; child pleased
11. Passenger carefully steps down from a bus onto sidewalk, normal intact feet and steps, full body visible
12. At home doorway one friend leaves walking toward own house while friends wave goodbye; clear departure and farewell
13. Family enjoys shade of leafy tree and farmers benefit from sunshine and gentle rain growing crops; natural benefits
14. Clever child solves reaching toy on high shelf by safely using stable step stool rather than wobbly stack; thoughtful planning
15. Child bites into a large whole red apple, teeth touching apple and clear bite mark
16. Child chews a mouthful of rice at meal, lips closed, slight cheek motion marks, chopsticks lowered; no swallowing or open-mouth eating

assets.meaning: 前へ進むのではなく、車などが後ろに向かって下がること。
assets.prompt:
Create ONE square 4 by 4 contact sheet, EXACTLY 16 equally sized square illustrations, white straight narrow gutters. Row-major order, four columns and four rows. Warm clear Japanese elementary-school picture-book watercolor style. Every cell is independent and fits entirely inside its square with margin. No captions, titles, numbering or watermarks. assets.meaning: 水などの液体を入れるための容器。
assets.prompt:
Create a square contact sheet with exactly SIXTEEN distinct equally sized illustrations in a precise uniform 4 by 4 grid. Reading order left to right top to bottom. All objects wholly inside their cell with ample margin, thin white gutters. Warm clean children's educational picture-book watercolor, gentle outlines, simple pale backgrounds, biologically accurate animals and plants, no human faces on animals, no text labels numbers logos watermarks. Scenes:
1. Several blank white paper sheets, one corner curled.
2. An empty clear drinking tumbler.
3. A realistic fish with gill cover and distinct fins swimming.
4. Cherry tree branch with pale pink blossoms and characteristic notched petals.
5. A Japanese macaque monkey with gray-brown fur and reddish bare face.
6. Fine white salt crystals in a small bowl, wooden spoon nearby.
7. A stag with branched antlers standing in woodland.
8. Whole striped watermelon with red sliced wedge and black seeds.
9. A bar of soap on dish with a few bubbles.
10. An expansive clear blue daytime sky with fluffy white clouds.
11. A realistic octopus underwater showing exactly eight arms with suckers, no extra arms.
12. A whole chicken egg and a cracked egg with shell, white and yellow yolk.
13. A natural butterfly perched on flower, two pairs of wings (four wings total), six legs.
14. A simple wooden study desk with notebook and pencil on top.
15. Ripe red tomatoes with green star shaped calyx.
16. Shiny purple eggplants with green caps.

assets.meaning: 土のなかにふかくのびる、細くて茶色いお野菜。
assets.prompt: Edit the supplied reference contact sheets into a NEW corrected 3 by 3 contact sheet, exactly 9 equal square panels in row-major order. Retain warm natural educational watercolor picture-book style, anatomically and mechanically accurate, ivory backgrounds, NO text numbers borders labels or watermark, ample margins so each entire subject is safely inside its panel. Each panel is independent. Row 1: (1) Water strider viewed from above on pond: elongated slim dark body, exactly six legs attached to thorax, short front pair, very long middle and hind pairs, two antennae, ripple contact points. (2) String figure ayatori: two children's hands, exactly five fingers each, red closed string loop clearly hooked around each thumb and little finger, crossed string strands tensioned between hands, credible cat's cradle string topology. (3) Unicycle: exactly one wheel, saddle centered above straight seat post, two fork blades ending at wheel axle, opposing pedal cranks directly connected to central axle, no extra hubs or rods. Row 2: (4) Traditional Japanese kimono worn by standing adult, left front over right, full wide sleeves, obi properly wrapping waist, no display rack. (5) Accurate B-flat clarinet complete: black reed mouthpiece, short barrel, cylindrical keyed upper and lower joints, shiny silver keys and round tone-hole covers, modest flared bell, no trumpet valves. (6) Whole burdock gobo roots, long thin brown irregular roots gradually tapering to very fine tips, one cut end visible. Row 3: (7) Sesame seeds close-up in small bowl and scattered seeds: tiny flattened elongated tear/oval shapes with tapered tip, ivory, not round balls. (8) One white die three-quarter view: visible top THREE pips, front ONE pip, right TWO pips, exact consistent dot spacing, no second die. (9) Sugar in white bowl and teaspoon as main subject, small accompanying scene behind: child smiling while tasting a spoonful of sweet yogurt mixed with sugar, jar of sugar beside yogurt. All nine panels must have clear separate non-overlapping compositions.

assets.prompt:
Create exactly sixteen separate warm watercolor illustrations for a Japanese children’s vocabulary app in one perfectly regular 4 by 4 contact sheet. Square overall canvas, four equal columns and four equal rows, row-major order left to right then top to bottom. Every cell has a white background and generous safe margins; illustration centered completely inside its cell, no touching or overlapping neighboring cells. No text, letters, numerals, captions, labels, logos, watermarks, decorative borders or visible gridlines. Each subject must be visually clear at small size, child-friendly, natural proportions, soft paper texture, gentle warm colors, crisp identifiable silhouette. Follow the sixteen subjects in EXACT order.
Row 1, column 1: A ceramic bowl heaped with cooked white rice, steam gently rising.
Row 1, column 2: Three long thin brown burdock roots with rough earthy skin, one cut end showing pale flesh.
Row 1, column 3: A small shallow bowl filled with tiny ivory sesame seeds, a few seeds scattered nearby.
Row 1, column 4: A simple blue household trash bin with a lid and one crumpled paper inside.
Row 2, column 1: A friendly anatomically recognizable black gorilla sitting on grass.
Row 2, column 2: A gray rhinoceros with a prominent nasal horn, standing sideways.
Row 2, column 3: Two white six-sided dice with black dot pips.
Row 2, column 4: An open brown wallet with blank banknotes and a plain card inside.
Row 3, column 1: A fishing rod with handle, reel, long slender pole and hanging fishing line.
Row 3, column 2: A white heron with long neck, long legs and pointed bill standing in shallow water.
Row 3, column 3: A short wooden picket fence with evenly spaced upright posts.
Row 3, column 4: A pair of ripe red cherries joined by green stems and a leaf.
Row 4, column 1: A complete silver salmon fish with dark speckled back, swimming in clear water; not alcohol.
Row 4, column 2: A clump of bamboo grass with slender stems and long pointed green leaves.
Row 4, column 3: Sliced raw pink salmon and white fish sashimi arranged neatly on a small plate.
Row 4, column 4: A single silver eating spoon, complete handle and concave bowl.

assets.prompt:
Create exactly sixteen separate warm watercolor illustrations for a Japanese children’s vocabulary app in one perfectly regular 4 by 4 contact sheet. Square overall canvas, four equal columns and four equal rows, row-major order left to right then top to bottom. Every cell has a white background and generous safe margins; illustration centered completely inside its cell, no touching or overlapping neighboring cells. No text, letters, numerals, captions, labels, logos, watermarks, decorative borders or visible gridlines. Each subject must be visually clear at small size, child-friendly, natural proportions, soft paper texture, gentle warm colors, crisp identifiable silhouette. Follow the sixteen subjects in EXACT order.
Row 1, column 1: A ceramic bowl heaped with cooked white rice, steam gently rising.
Row 1, column 2: Three long thin brown burdock roots with rough earthy skin, one cut end showing pale flesh.
Row 1, column 3: A small shallow bowl filled with tiny ivory sesame seeds, a few seeds scattered nearby.
Row 1, column 4: A simple blue household trash bin with a lid and one crumpled paper inside.
Row 2, column 1: A friendly anatomically recognizable black gorilla sitting on grass.
Row 2, column 2: A gray rhinoceros with a prominent nasal horn, standing sideways.
Row 2, column 3: Two white six-sided dice with black dot pips.
Row 2, column 4: An open brown wallet with blank banknotes and a plain card inside.
Row 3, column 1: A fishing rod with handle, reel, long slender pole and hanging fishing line.
Row 3, column 2: A white heron with long neck, long legs and pointed bill standing in shallow water.
Row 3, column 3: A short wooden picket fence with evenly spaced upright posts.
Row 3, column 4: A pair of ripe red cherries joined by green stems and a leaf.
Row 4, column 1: A complete silver salmon fish with dark speckled back, swimming in clear water; not alcohol.
Row 4, column 2: A clump of bamboo grass with slender stems and long pointed green leaves.
Row 4, column 3: Sliced raw pink salmon and white fish sashimi arranged neatly on a small plate.
Row 4, column 4: A single silver eating spoon, complete handle and concave bowl.

assets.prompt:
Create a square contact sheet with exactly SIXTEEN distinct equally sized illustrations in a precise uniform 4 by 4 grid. Reading order left to right top to bottom. All objects wholly inside their cell with ample margin, thin white gutters. Warm clean children's educational picture-book watercolor, gentle outlines, simple pale backgrounds, biologically accurate animals and plants, no human faces on animals, no text labels numbers logos watermarks. Scenes:
1. Several blank white paper sheets, one corner curled.
2. An empty clear drinking tumbler.
3. A realistic fish with gill cover and distinct fins swimming.
4. Cherry tree branch with pale pink blossoms and characteristic notched petals.
5. A Japanese macaque monkey with gray-brown fur and reddish bare face.
6. Fine white salt crystals in a small bowl, wooden spoon nearby.
7. A stag with branched antlers standing in woodland.
8. Whole striped watermelon with red sliced wedge and black seeds.
9. A bar of soap on dish with a few bubbles.
10. An expansive clear blue daytime sky with fluffy white clouds.
11. A realistic octopus underwater showing exactly eight arms with suckers, no extra arms.
12. A whole chicken egg and a cracked egg with shell, white and yellow yolk.
13. A natural butterfly perched on flower, two pairs of wings (four wings total), six legs.
14. A simple wooden study desk with notebook and pencil on top.
15. Ripe red tomatoes with green star shaped calyx.
16. Shiny purple eggplants with green caps.

assets.prompt:
Create a square contact sheet with exactly SIXTEEN distinct equally sized illustrations in a precise uniform 4 by 4 grid. Reading order left to right top to bottom. All objects wholly inside their cell with ample margin, thin white gutters. Warm clean children's educational picture-book watercolor, gentle outlines, simple pale backgrounds, biologically accurate animals and plants, no human faces on animals, no text labels numbers logos watermarks. Scenes:
1. Several blank white paper sheets, one corner curled.
2. An empty clear drinking tumbler.
3. A realistic fish with gill cover and distinct fins swimming.
4. Cherry tree branch with pale pink blossoms and characteristic notched petals.
5. A Japanese macaque monkey with gray-brown fur and reddish bare face.
6. Fine white salt crystals in a small bowl, wooden spoon nearby.
7. A stag with branched antlers standing in woodland.
8. Whole striped watermelon with red sliced wedge and black seeds.
9. A bar of soap on dish with a few bubbles.
10. An expansive clear blue daytime sky with fluffy white clouds.
11. A realistic octopus underwater showing exactly eight arms with suckers, no extra arms.
12. A whole chicken egg and a cracked egg with shell, white and yellow yolk.
13. A natural butterfly perched on flower, two pairs of wings (four wings total), six legs.
14. A simple wooden study desk with notebook and pencil on top.
15. Ripe red tomatoes with green star shaped calyx.
16. Shiny purple eggplants with green caps.

assets.meaning: 魚介類などを生のまま切り分けた料理。魚の刺身がよく知られる。
assets.prompt:
Create exactly sixteen separate warm watercolor illustrations for a Japanese children’s vocabulary app in one perfectly regular 4 by 4 contact sheet. Square overall canvas, four equal columns and four equal rows, row-major order left to right then top to bottom. Every cell has a white background and generous safe margins; illustration centered completely inside its cell, no touching or overlapping neighboring cells. No text, letters, numerals, captions, labels, logos, watermarks, decorative borders or visible gridlines. Each subject must be visually clear at small size, child-friendly, natural proportions, soft paper texture, gentle warm colors, crisp identifiable silhouette. Follow the sixteen subjects in EXACT order.
Row 1, column 1: A ceramic bowl heaped with cooked white rice, steam gently rising.
Row 1, column 2: Three long thin brown burdock roots with rough earthy skin, one cut end showing pale flesh.
Row 1, column 3: A small shallow bowl filled with tiny ivory sesame seeds, a few seeds scattered nearby.
Row 1, column 4: A simple blue household trash bin with a lid and one crumpled paper inside.
Row 2, column 1: A friendly anatomically recognizable black gorilla sitting on grass.
Row 2, column 2: A gray rhinoceros with a prominent nasal horn, standing sideways.
Row 2, column 3: Two white six-sided dice with black dot pips.
Row 2, column 4: An open brown wallet with blank banknotes and a plain card inside.
Row 3, column 1: A fishing rod with handle, reel, long slender pole and hanging fishing line.
Row 3, column 2: A white heron with long neck, long legs and pointed bill standing in shallow water.
Row 3, column 3: A short wooden picket fence with evenly spaced upright posts.
Row 3, column 4: A pair of ripe red cherries joined by green stems and a leaf.
Row 4, column 1: A complete silver salmon fish with dark speckled back, swimming in clear water; not alcohol.
Row 4, column 2: A clump of bamboo grass with slender stems and long pointed green leaves.
Row 4, column 3: Sliced raw pink salmon and white fish sashimi arranged neatly on a small plate.
Row 4, column 4: A single silver eating spoon, complete handle and concave bowl.

assets.prompt:
Create exactly sixteen separate warm watercolor illustrations for a Japanese children’s vocabulary app in one perfectly regular 4 by 4 contact sheet. Square overall canvas, four equal columns and four equal rows, row-major order left to right then top to bottom. Every cell has a white background and generous safe margins; illustration centered completely inside its cell, no touching or overlapping neighboring cells. No text, letters, numerals, captions, labels, logos, watermarks, decorative borders or visible gridlines. Each subject must be visually clear at small size, child-friendly, natural proportions, soft paper texture, gentle warm colors, crisp identifiable silhouette. Follow the sixteen subjects in EXACT order.
Row 1, column 1: Two purple sweet potatoes, one cut open to reveal yellow flesh.
Row 1, column 2: A small bowl of white granular sugar with a spoonful lifted beside it.
Row 1, column 3: A complete silver blue mackerel fish with unmistakable dark wavy stripes on its back.
Row 1, column 4: Golden desert sand dunes under a pale blue sky.
Row 2, column 1: A green branching cactus with small spines in a terracotta pot.
Row 2, column 2: A friendly gray shark swimming sideways, recognizable dorsal fin and gill slits.
Row 2, column 3: Three flat green snow pea pods, one opened to show tiny peas.
Row 2, column 4: A single empty round shallow ceramic plate, white with a blue rim.
Row 3, column 1: A bowl of fresh salad with lettuce, red tomato and cucumber slices.
Row 3, column 2: A pair of dark-lensed sunglasses with both arms visible.
Row 3, column 3: A pair of simple summer sandals with foot straps and visible open toes.
Row 3, column 4: Two triangular sandwiches showing bread, lettuce, tomato and egg filling.
Row 4, column 1: A long slender whole Pacific saury fish with silver body and blue back.
Row 4, column 2: A red child-size pedal tricycle with exactly three wheels, handlebars and seat.
Row 4, column 3: A whole red pomegranate and a cut half filled with distinct red seeds.
Row 4, column 4: A red crayfish with two large claws, segmented tail and many small legs by a stream.

CRITICAL SAFE SPACING: Every illustration must fit within the CENTRAL 70 percent of its 4x4 equal grid cell. Leave at least 15 percent of the cell white on every side. The LONG SAURY FISH at row 4 column 1 must be SMALL, SHORT IN IMAGE, entirely inside its cell with its nose and tail clear of both edges. All cells have generous white space, absolutely no objects spilling into another cell.

2. An empty clear drinking tumbler.
3. A realistic fish with gill cover and distinct fins swimming.

5. A Japanese macaque monkey with gray-brown fur and reddish bare face.
6. Fine white salt crystals in a small bowl, wooden spoon nearby.
7. A stag with branched antlers standing in woodland.
8. Whole striped watermelon with red sliced wedge and black seeds.
9. A bar of soap on dish with a few bubbles.
10. An expansive clear blue daytime sky with fluffy white clouds.
11. A realistic octopus underwater showing exactly eight arms with suckers, no extra arms.
12. A whole chicken egg and a cracked egg with shell, white and yellow yolk.
13. A natural butterfly perched on flower, two pairs of wings (four wings total), six legs.
14. A simple wooden study desk with notebook and pencil on top.
15. Ripe red tomatoes with green star shaped calyx.
16. Shiny purple eggplants with green caps.

assets.meaning: 強い光をおさえるための色付きレンズのめがね。
assets.prompt:
Create exactly sixteen separate warm watercolor illustrations for a Japanese children’s vocabulary app in one perfectly regular 4 by 4 contact sheet. Square overall canvas, four equal columns and four equal rows, row-major order left to right then top to bottom. Every cell has a white background and generous safe margins; illustration centered completely inside its cell, no touching or overlapping neighboring cells. No text, letters, numerals, captions, labels, logos, watermarks, decorative borders or visible gridlines. Each subject must be visually clear at small size, child-friendly, natural proportions, soft paper texture, gentle warm colors, crisp identifiable silhouette. Follow the sixteen subjects in EXACT order.
Row 1, column 1: Two purple sweet potatoes, one cut open to reveal yellow flesh.
Row 1, column 2: A small bowl of white granular sugar with a spoonful lifted beside it.
Row 1, column 3: A complete silver blue mackerel fish with unmistakable dark wavy stripes on its back.
Row 1, column 4: Golden desert sand dunes under a pale blue sky.
Row 2, column 1: A green branching cactus with small spines in a terracotta pot.
Row 2, column 2: A friendly gray shark swimming sideways, recognizable dorsal fin and gill slits.
Row 2, column 3: Three flat green snow pea pods, one opened to show tiny peas.
Row 2, column 4: A single empty round shallow ceramic plate, white with a blue rim.
Row 3, column 1: A bowl of fresh salad with lettuce, red tomato and cucumber slices.
Row 3, column 2: A pair of dark-lensed sunglasses with both arms visible.
Row 3, column 3: A pair of simple summer sandals with foot straps and visible open toes.
Row 3, column 4: Two triangular sandwiches showing bread, lettuce, tomato and egg filling.
Row 4, column 1: A long slender whole Pacific saury fish with silver body and blue back.
Row 4, column 2: A red child-size pedal tricycle with exactly three wheels, handlebars and seat.
Row 4, column 3: A whole red pomegranate and a cut half filled with distinct red seeds.
Row 4, column 4: A red crayfish with two large claws, segmented tail and many small legs by a stream.

CRITICAL SAFE SPACING: Every illustration must fit within the CENTRAL 70 percent of its 4x4 equal grid cell. Leave at least 15 percent of the cell white on every side. The LONG SAURY FISH at row 4 column 1 must be SMALL, SHORT IN IMAGE, entirely inside its cell with its nose and tail clear of both edges. All cells have generous white space, absolutely no objects spilling into another cell.

assets.meaning: 前の言葉の最後の音から始まる言葉を続けていく言葉遊び。
assets.prompt:
Create ONE square 4 by 4 contact sheet, EXACTLY 16 equally sized square illustrations, white straight narrow gutters. Row-major order, four columns and four rows. Warm clear Japanese elementary-school picture-book watercolor style. Every cell is independent and fits entirely inside its square with margin. No captions, titles, numbering or watermarks. Follow each cell scene literally, especially action direction and objects.
Cell 1 (row 1, column 1), 鼻歌: A smiling child softly HUMS while tidying books. Lips are CLOSED, cheeks relaxed, a few soft music-note symbols near the closed mouth. No microphone or wide-open singing mouth. Gentle humming.
Cell 2 (row 1, column 2), 甘塩: A small grilled salmon fillet and a tiny pinch of salt between fingers. Only three tiny grains sprinkled lightly, with a happy child tasting the mild salted fish. NO pile of salt or heap of crystals. Mild and lightly salted food.
Cell 3 (row 1, column 3), 洗いざらい: A child empties every single toy block from a box onto a table. The box is tilted and visibly completely empty. All blocks are now on the table, none left inside. Meaning everything without leaving anything out. NO washing or laundry.
Cell 4 (row 1, column 4), 居座り: A stubborn fully clothed adult remains sitting on a chair with arms folded and feet firmly planted. A host stands beside the open exit door and gestures kindly for the adult to leave; seated adult clearly refuses to move. No comfortable napping.
Cell 5 (row 2, column 1), 一石二鳥: One central action: planting one fruit tree. Two clear result bubbles linked from that one tree: on the left, a basket of apples harvested; on the right, a family resting in its cool shade. One effort produces TWO good benefits. No stone or birds.
Cell 6 (row 2, column 2), 鰻登り: A shop owner is amazed by a sales chart rising very steeply from low left to high right, with coin stacks that rise steeply in the same direction. Shows rapid steep growth. NO eel or waterfall.
Cell 7 (row 2, column 3), オウンゴール: A soccer defender in a BLUE jersey accidentally kicks the ball backward into the goal guarded by their own BLUE-jersey goalkeeper. Both BLUE teammates look dismayed. An opposing RED-jersey player outside the goal celebrates. Clear ball arrow leads from BLUE defender to own goal. No mixed teammate colors.
Cell 8 (row 2, column 4), 行政: A municipal city-hall public-service counter. A civil servant processes a resident's application and hands back an official certificate. Small thought bubbles show public garbage collection and repaired streetlights, representing everyday government services implementing rules. NO parliament debate or legislature building.
Cell 9 (row 3, column 1), 献血: A calm fully clothed ADULT volunteer donates blood at a medical donation center. Nurse assists the arm. Tubing from the covered adult forearm runs DOWN to a collection bag resting on a small scale BELOW the arm, on a low trolley. NO hanging IV bag above the arm, no transfusion flowing into the person, no wound or exposed needle or visible puncture. The collected red liquid stays only inside the sealed bag and tubing.
Cell 10 (row 3, column 2), 後退: Side view of a car pointing RIGHT (headlights and hood on the right, rear tail lights on the left). A big arrow under the car points LEFT, showing reversing backward opposite the car's forward direction. Driver looks back over shoulder. Keep hood/rear and arrow unambiguous.
Cell 11 (row 3, column 3), 後転: A backward gym roll in three small stages within one cell, on a soft mat, same person facing LEFT at start and at end. Stage left: crouching, facing left, feet flat and knees tucked. Middle: rolling BACK toward the RIGHT over a rounded back with knees tucked, feet travel over the head to the right, hands beside ears. Right: finishes crouched facing LEFT again. Never change facing direction. A curved arrow points from start to finish to the RIGHT.
Cell 12 (row 3, column 4), しりとり: Japanese shiritori word chain represented by exactly FOUR clear picture icons in order, with arrows: RED APPLE (りんご) → GORILLA (ごりら) → TRUMPET (らっぱ) → PANDA (ぱんだ). Two happy children point at the pictures. The Japanese words correctly connect GO, RA, PA. No writing is necessary; picture identities must be obvious. No monkey, orange, or deer.
Cell 13 (row 4, column 1), 血みどろ: A WHITE torn shirt lying by itself on a chair, mostly covered in RED blood stains. No body wearing it, no wounds or hurt person. A first-aid kit is nearby and a calm fully clothed adult folds a clean replacement white shirt. Non-graphic symbolic aftermath. Clearly white fabric with red stains, never a plain red shirt.
Cell 14 (row 4, column 2), 偽物: Compare a real red apple cut open with real seeds and juicy pale fruit, and a lookalike FAKE plastic red apple that has popped apart into two hollow red shells with a visible seam. A child is surprised by the plastic apple. The fake has no flesh or seeds. No two stuffed toys or identical real apples.
Cell 15 (row 4, column 3), 濡れ手に粟: Fictional metaphor: a relaxed ADULT lightly presses just ONE small button with ONE fingertip. The automatic device instantly delivers a huge pile of gold coins into a basket. Two visual emphases: tiny effort and very large reward. No gambling, no stealing, no grain, no wet hands. Illustrates making large profits with little effort.
Cell 16 (row 4, column 4), 根強い: Lasting popularity over generations: an elderly grandfather shows a sepia photograph of himself as a young boy happily playing KENDAMA, while his smiling young grandchild beside him plays the SAME traditional kendama now. Longtime affection for the same toy. One photo in the background, present people large in foreground. No tree or literal roots.

Create exactly sixteen separate warm watercolor illustrations for a Japanese children’s vocabulary app in one perfectly regular 4 by 4 contact sheet. Square overall canvas, four equal columns and four equal rows, row-major order left to right then top to bottom. Every cell has a white background and generous safe margins; illustration centered completely inside its cell, no touching or overlapping neighboring cells. No text, letters, numerals, captions, labels, logos, watermarks, decorative borders or visible gridlines. Each subject must be visually clear at small size, child-friendly, natural proportions, soft paper texture, gentle warm colors, crisp identifiable silhouette. Follow the sixteen subjects in EXACT order.
Row 1, column 1: Three earthy brown potatoes, one cut in half showing pale yellow interior.
Row 1, column 2: A rectangular soft woven rug with a simple colorful pattern lying on a floor.
Row 1, column 3: A woven bird nest containing three pale eggs resting on a branch.
Row 1, column 4: A recognizable black skunk with two bold white stripes and a fluffy raised tail.
Row 2, column 1: A neatly displayed knee-length pleated purple skirt.
Row 2, column 2: A shallow sukiyaki cooking pot filled with thin beef slices, tofu, green onion and mushrooms.
Row 2, column 3: A platter of recognizable nigiri sushi with white rice and fish toppings and two seaweed rolls.
Row 2, column 4: A small golden round jingle bell with slit opening and tiny hanging loop.
Row 3, column 1: A rolled bamboo slat window blind partly lowered against a window.
Row 3, column 2: A full-body green stegosaurus with large upright plates along its back and tail spikes.
Row 3, column 3: A thick cooked steak with grill marks on a plate beside a fork.
Row 3, column 4: A playground sandbox with sand, a small toy bucket and shovel.
Row 4, column 1: A plate of long spaghetti noodles in red tomato sauce with a fork.
Row 4, column 2: A complete playground slide with ladder, smooth sloping chute and safe side rails.
Row 4, column 3: A yellow porous kitchen dishwashing sponge with a green scrubber layer.
Row 4, column 4: A matching pair of cozy indoor slippers with open heels.

Keep each image entirely in the CENTRAL 75 percent width and height of its own equal cell. No subject can extend beyond that safe area.

assets.prompt:
Create a square contact sheet with exactly SIXTEEN distinct equally sized illustrations in a precise uniform 4 by 4 grid. Reading order left to right top to bottom. All objects wholly inside their cell with ample margin, thin white gutters. Warm clean children's educational picture-book watercolor, gentle outlines, simple pale backgrounds, biologically accurate animals and plants, no human faces on animals, no text labels numbers logos watermarks. Scenes:
1. Several blank white paper sheets, one corner curled.
2. An empty clear drinking tumbler.
3. A realistic fish with gill cover and distinct fins swimming.
4. Cherry tree branch with pale pink blossoms and characteristic notched petals.
5. A Japanese macaque monkey with gray-brown fur and reddish bare face.
6. Fine white salt crystals in a small bowl, wooden spoon nearby.
7. A stag with branched antlers standing in woodland.
8. Whole striped watermelon with red sliced wedge and black seeds.
9. A bar of soap on dish with a few bubbles.
10. An expansive clear blue daytime sky with fluffy white clouds.
11. A realistic octopus underwater showing exactly eight arms with suckers, no extra arms.
12. A whole chicken egg and a cracked egg with shell, white and yellow yolk.
13. A natural butterfly perched on flower, two pairs of wings (four wings total), six legs.
14. A simple wooden study desk with notebook and pencil on top.
15. Ripe red tomatoes with green star shaped calyx.
16. Shiny purple eggplants with green caps.

assets.prompt:
Create a square contact sheet with exactly SIXTEEN distinct equally sized illustrations in a precise uniform 4 by 4 grid. Reading order left to right top to bottom. All objects wholly inside their cell with ample margin, thin white gutters. Warm clean children's educational picture-book watercolor, gentle outlines, simple pale backgrounds, biologically accurate animals and plants, no human faces on animals, no text labels numbers logos watermarks. Scenes:
1. Several blank white paper sheets, one corner curled.
2. An empty clear drinking tumbler.
3. A realistic fish with gill cover and distinct fins swimming.
4. Cherry tree branch with pale pink blossoms and characteristic notched petals.
5. A Japanese macaque monkey with gray-brown fur and reddish bare face.
6. Fine white salt crystals in a small bowl, wooden spoon nearby.
7. A stag with branched antlers standing in woodland.
8. Whole striped watermelon with red sliced wedge and black seeds.
9. A bar of soap on dish with a few bubbles.
10. An expansive clear blue daytime sky with fluffy white clouds.
11. A realistic octopus underwater showing exactly eight arms with suckers, no extra arms.
12. A whole chicken egg and a cracked egg with shell, white and yellow yolk.
13. A natural butterfly perched on flower, two pairs of wings (four wings total), six legs.
14. A simple wooden study desk with notebook and pencil on top.
15. Ripe red tomatoes with green star shaped calyx.
16. Shiny purple eggplants with green caps.

assets.meaning: 八本の腕に吸盤を持つ海の生き物。危険を感じると墨を吐く。
assets.prompt:
Create a square contact sheet with exactly SIXTEEN distinct equally sized illustrations in a precise uniform 4 by 4 grid. Reading order left to right top to bottom. All objects wholly inside their cell with ample margin, thin white gutters. Warm clean children's educational picture-book watercolor, gentle outlines, simple pale backgrounds, biologically accurate animals and plants, no human faces on animals, no text labels numbers logos watermarks. Scenes:
1. Several blank white paper sheets, one corner curled.
2. An empty clear drinking tumbler.
3. A realistic fish with gill cover and distinct fins swimming.
4. Cherry tree branch with pale pink blossoms and characteristic notched petals.
5. A Japanese macaque monkey with gray-brown fur and reddish bare face.
6. Fine white salt crystals in a small bowl, wooden spoon nearby.
7. A stag with branched antlers standing in woodland.
8. Whole striped watermelon with red sliced wedge and black seeds.
9. A bar of soap on dish with a few bubbles.
10. An expansive clear blue daytime sky with fluffy white clouds.
11. A realistic octopus underwater showing exactly eight arms with suckers, no extra arms.
12. A whole chicken egg and a cracked egg with shell, white and yellow yolk.
13. A natural butterfly perched on flower, two pairs of wings (four wings total), six legs.
14. A simple wooden study desk with notebook and pencil on top.
15. Ripe red tomatoes with green star shaped calyx.
16. Shiny purple eggplants with green caps.

Warm clean children's educational picture-book watercolor, gentle outlines, simple pale backgrounds, biologically accurate animals and plants, no human faces on animals, no text labels numbers logos watermarks. Scenes:
1. Several blank white paper sheets, one corner curled.
2. An empty clear drinking tumbler.
3. A realistic fish with gill cover and distinct fins swimming.
4. Cherry tree branch with pale pink blossoms and characteristic notched petals.
5. A Japanese macaque monkey with gray-brown fur and reddish bare face.
6. Fine white salt crystals in a small bowl, wooden spoon nearby.
7. A stag with branched antlers standing in woodland.
8. Whole striped watermelon with red sliced wedge and black seeds.
9. A bar of soap on dish with a few bubbles.
10. An expansive clear blue daytime sky with fluffy white clouds.
11. A realistic octopus underwater showing exactly eight arms with suckers, no extra arms.
12. A whole chicken egg and a cracked egg with shell, white and yellow yolk.
13. A natural butterfly perched on flower, two pairs of wings (four wings total), six legs.
14. A simple wooden study desk with notebook and pencil on top.
15. Ripe red tomatoes with green star shaped calyx.
16. Shiny purple eggplants with green caps.

assets.meaning: 血にまみれてひどく傷ついた状態。争いが激しいようすにも使う。
assets.prompt:
Create ONE square 4 by 4 contact sheet, EXACTLY 16 equally sized square illustrations, white straight narrow gutters. Row-major order, four columns and four rows. Warm clear Japanese elementary-school picture-book watercolor style. Every cell is independent and fits entirely inside its square with margin. No captions, titles, numbering or watermarks. Follow each cell scene literally, especially action direction and objects.
Cell 1 (row 1, column 1), 鼻歌: A smiling child softly HUMS while tidying books. Lips are CLOSED, cheeks relaxed, a few soft music-note symbols near the closed mouth. No microphone or wide-open singing mouth. Gentle humming.
Cell 2 (row 1, column 2), 甘塩: A small grilled salmon fillet and a tiny pinch of salt between fingers. Only three tiny grains sprinkled lightly, with a happy child tasting the mild salted fish. NO pile of salt or heap of crystals. Mild and lightly salted food.
Cell 3 (row 1, column 3), 洗いざらい: A child empties every single toy block from a box onto a table. The box is tilted and visibly completely empty. All blocks are now on the table, none left inside. Meaning everything without leaving anything out. NO washing or laundry.
Cell 4 (row 1, column 4), 居座り: A stubborn fully clothed adult remains sitting on a chair with arms folded and feet firmly planted. A host stands beside the open exit door and gestures kindly for the adult to leave; seated adult clearly refuses to move. No comfortable napping.
Cell 5 (row 2, column 1), 一石二鳥: One central action: planting one fruit tree. Two clear result bubbles linked from that one tree: on the left, a basket of apples harvested; on the right, a family resting in its cool shade. One effort produces TWO good benefits. No stone or birds.
Cell 6 (row 2, column 2), 鰻登り: A shop owner is amazed by a sales chart rising very steeply from low left to high right, with coin stacks that rise steeply in the same direction. Shows rapid steep growth. NO eel or waterfall.
Cell 7 (row 2, column 3), オウンゴール: A soccer defender in a BLUE jersey accidentally kicks the ball backward into the goal guarded by their own BLUE-jersey goalkeeper. Both BLUE teammates look dismayed. An opposing RED-jersey player outside the goal celebrates. Clear ball arrow leads from BLUE defender to own goal. No mixed teammate colors.
Cell 8 (row 2, column 4), 行政: A municipal city-hall public-service counter. A civil servant processes a resident's application and hands back an official certificate. Small thought bubbles show public garbage collection and repaired streetlights, representing everyday government services implementing rules. NO parliament debate or legislature building.
Cell 9 (row 3, column 1), 献血: A calm fully clothed ADULT volunteer donates blood at a medical donation center. Nurse assists the arm. Tubing from the covered adult forearm runs DOWN to a collection bag resting on a small scale BELOW the arm, on a low trolley. NO hanging IV bag above the arm, no transfusion flowing into the person, no wound or exposed needle or visible puncture. The collected red liquid stays only inside the sealed bag and tubing.
Cell 10 (row 3, column 2), 後退: Side view of a car pointing RIGHT (headlights and hood on the right, rear tail lights on the left). A big arrow under the car points LEFT, showing reversing backward opposite the car's forward direction. Driver looks back over shoulder. Keep hood/rear and arrow unambiguous.
Cell 11 (row 3, column 3), 後転: A backward gym roll in three small stages within one cell, on a soft mat, same person facing LEFT at start and at end. Stage left: crouching, facing left, feet flat and knees tucked. Middle: rolling BACK toward the RIGHT over a rounded back with knees tucked, feet travel over the head to the right, hands beside ears. Right: finishes crouched facing LEFT again. Never change facing direction. A curved arrow points from start to finish to the RIGHT.
Cell 12 (row 3, column 4), しりとり: Japanese shiritori word chain represented by exactly FOUR clear picture icons in order, with arrows: RED APPLE (りんご) → GORILLA (ごりら) → TRUMPET (らっぱ) → PANDA (ぱんだ). Two happy children point at the pictures. The Japanese words correctly connect GO, RA, PA. No writing is necessary; picture identities must be obvious. No monkey, orange, or deer.
Cell 13 (row 4, column 1), 血みどろ: A WHITE torn shirt lying by itself on a chair, mostly covered in RED blood stains. No body wearing it, no wounds or hurt person. A first-aid kit is nearby and a calm fully clothed adult folds a clean replacement white shirt. Non-graphic symbolic aftermath. Clearly white fabric with red stains, never a plain red shirt.
Cell 14 (row 4, column 2), 偽物: Compare a real red apple cut open with real seeds and juicy pale fruit, and a lookalike FAKE plastic red apple that has popped apart into two hollow red shells with a visible seam. A child is surprised by the plastic apple. The fake has no flesh or seeds. No two stuffed toys or identical real apples.
Cell 15 (row 4, column 3), 濡れ手に粟: Fictional metaphor: a relaxed ADULT lightly presses just ONE small button with ONE fingertip. The automatic device instantly delivers a huge pile of gold coins into a basket. Two visual emphases: tiny effort and very large reward. No gambling, no stealing, no grain, no wet hands. Illustrates making large profits with little effort.
Cell 16 (row 4, column 4), 根強い: Lasting popularity over generations: an elderly grandfather shows a sepia photograph of himself as a young boy happily playing KENDAMA, while his smiling young grandchild beside him plays the SAME traditional kendama now. Longtime affection for the same toy. One photo in the background, present people large in foreground. No tree or literal roots.

assets.meaning: 歩くときに手で持ち 地面について体を支える棒。
assets.prompt:
Create a square 4 by 4 contact sheet with EXACTLY 16 equal square cells, four rows and four columns. White background with clean thin white gutters exactly at quarter boundaries. Each cell is an independent warm watercolor illustration for Japanese young children, softly textured but clear recognizable subjects, natural shapes, gentle colors. Center each subject fully inside its cell with at least 10 percent safe empty margin so cropping never cuts it. No border frame, no text, no labels, no numbers, no logos, no overlap or shared backgrounds between cells. Use row-major order left to right, top to bottom. The sixteen cells must show exactly these subjects:
Row 1, column 1: A single wooden walking cane with a curved handle, standing diagonally.
Row 1, column 2: Several spring horsetail shoots with segmented tan stems and spore cones emerging from soil, Japanese tsukushi, not horse tails.
Row 1, column 3: A green ivy climbing vine with lobed leaves clinging to a short brick wall.
Row 1, column 4: A loose mound of rich brown garden soil with small crumbs, isolated.
Row 2, column 1: A hollow cardboard tube lying sideways with a clearly visible open circular end.
Row 2, column 2: A small azalea shrub covered in vivid pink trumpet shaped flowers.
Row 2, column 3: A neatly coiled thick twisted fiber rope, isolated.
Row 2, column 4: A red camellia flower with yellow stamens and glossy dark green leaves.
Row 3, column 1: A barn swallow in flight with narrow wings, forked tail and rusty throat.
Row 3, column 2: A small ceramic bowl of dark red sweet azuki bean paste with visible whole bean grains and a wooden spoon.
Row 3, column 3: A rounded brown ceramic storage jar with a narrow open mouth.
Row 3, column 4: A closed pink flower bud on a short green leafy stem, petals not yet open.
Row 4, column 1: A small tower made of colorful wooden toy blocks in cube triangle and cylinder shapes.
Row 4, column 2: A complete fishing rod with reel, gently curved tip and visible line, no fish.
Row 4, column 3: A single clean curved metal fishing hook with an eye and small barb, isolated.
Row 4, column 4: A morning glory vine stem curling around a wooden stake with green leaves and one blue flower.

Create a square contact sheet with exactly SIXTEEN distinct equally sized illustrations in a precise uniform 4 by 4 grid. Reading order left to right top to bottom. All objects wholly inside their cell with ample margin, thin white gutters. Warm clean children's educational picture-book watercolor, gentle outlines, simple pale backgrounds, biologically accurate animals and plants, no human faces on animals, no text labels numbers logos watermarks. Scenes:
1. A friendly domestic tabby cat sitting.
2. Thin dark green rectangular sheets of dried edible nori seaweed stacked on plate.
3. A brown wild boar with snout and short visible tusks.
4. A bottlenose dolphin swimming in blue sea, blowhole and horizontal tail flukes.
5. A white rabbit with long upright ears.
6. A small brown Eurasian tree sparrow with chestnut head and black cheek spot perched.
7. A whole yellow onion and cut half with concentric layers.
8. Earth's moon as a detailed pale cratered sphere against dark sky, no face.
9. A red crowned crane with long neck, long legs, white body and black flight feathers.
10. Orange carrots with fresh green tops.
11. A small natural gray mouse with round ears, pointed muzzle and long thin tail.
12. A ripe red apple and cut half showing seed core.
13. A bunch of yellow bananas with one partly peeled.
14. A giant panda with natural black white fur eating bamboo.
15. A tall sunflower with yellow petals and dark central disc.
16. A natural penguin standing on rocky Antarctic shore, flippers and webbed feet.

assets.prompt:
Create one carefully aligned 4 column by 4 row contact sheet of separate children picture-book illustrations. Warm painted style, gentle expressive faces, complete anatomically correct subjects. EXACTLY equal-sized square cells, clean white gutters. Keep all scene content comfortably inside its own cell with 8 percent empty margins, never overlap cells. No labels, no captions, no letters, no watermark; numbers only when specifically requested. Every cell is independent; ordered left to right then top to bottom. No extra rows or thumbnail strips. Each cell should tell its own story. Scenes:
1. Child prepares to go out, putting on shoes beside backpack and coat in entryway
2. Energetic young girl with ponytail playfully climbs a sturdy low playground climbing frame; visibly a girl
3. Two toy motorcars tested on same track: old dented car struggling far behind sleek faster car; stopwatch and finish ribbon make lower performance clear
4. Child startled by jack-in-box springing open: wide eyes, raised eyebrows, open round mouth, shoulders lifted
5. Hungry child waits for food holding belly, frowning with discomfort, empty plate on table; no smile
6. Child sitting up in bed realizes overslept, startled worried face, bedside clock shows late morning and sunlight enters; bedding clear
7. Three children each work on their own different craft at shared table: one paints, one folds paper, one builds blocks
8. Grandparent orally tells a story to children gathered on sofa; mouth speaking and expressive gestures; story bubble shows a friendly dragon, no letter
9. Lifeguard extends rescue ring to child struggling in water: child eyes worried, mouth open gasping, arms holding ring; helper close and safety assured; gentle no graphic distress
10. Chocolate box opened with clearly visible chocolates as main product and small inexpensive plastic toy car included as bonus; child pleased
11. Passenger carefully steps down from a bus onto sidewalk, normal intact feet and steps, full body visible
12. At home doorway one friend leaves walking toward own house while friends wave goodbye; clear departure and farewell
13. Family enjoys shade of leafy tree and farmers benefit from sunshine and gentle rain growing crops; natural benefits
14. Clever child solves reaching toy on high shelf by safely using stable step stool rather than wobbly stack; thoughtful planning
15. Child bites into a large whole red apple, teeth touching apple and clear bite mark
16. Child chews a mouthful of rice at meal, lips closed, slight cheek motion marks, chopsticks lowered; no swallowing or open-mouth eating

Each cell is an independent warm watercolor illustration for Japanese young children, softly textured but clear recognizable subjects, natural shapes, gentle colors. Center each subject fully inside its cell with at least 10 percent safe empty margin so cropping never cuts it. No border frame, no text, no labels, no numbers, no logos, no overlap or shared backgrounds between cells. Use row-major order left to right, top to bottom. The sixteen cells must show exactly these subjects:
Row 1, column 1: A single wooden walking cane with a curved handle, standing diagonally.
Row 1, column 2: Several spring horsetail shoots with segmented tan stems and spore cones emerging from soil, Japanese tsukushi, not horse tails.
Row 1, column 3: A green ivy climbing vine with lobed leaves clinging to a short brick wall.
Row 1, column 4: A loose mound of rich brown garden soil with small crumbs, isolated.
Row 2, column 1: A hollow cardboard tube lying sideways with a clearly visible open circular end.
Row 2, column 2: A small azalea shrub covered in vivid pink trumpet shaped flowers.
Row 2, column 3: A neatly coiled thick twisted fiber rope, isolated.
Row 2, column 4: A red camellia flower with yellow stamens and glossy dark green leaves.
Row 3, column 1: A barn swallow in flight with narrow wings, forked tail and rusty throat.
Row 3, column 2: A small ceramic bowl of dark red sweet azuki bean paste with visible whole bean grains and a wooden spoon.
Row 3, column 3: A rounded brown ceramic storage jar with a narrow open mouth.
Row 3, column 4: A closed pink flower bud on a short green leafy stem, petals not yet open.
Row 4, column 1: A small tower made of colorful wooden toy blocks in cube triangle and cylinder shapes.
Row 4, column 2: A complete fishing rod with reel, gently curved tip and visible line, no fish.
Row 4, column 3: A single clean curved metal fishing hook with an eye and small barb, isolated.
Row 4, column 4: A morning glory vine stem curling around a wooden stake with green leaves and one blue flower.

assets.prompt: Using reference educational watercolor illustrations as starting points, create corrected NEW 3 by 3 sheet with exactly 9 equal panels in row-major order. Ivory background, realistic friendly Japanese elementary dictionary illustrations. No text labels numbers borders watermarks. Generous safe margins each subject fully inside its own square. Row1: (1) Accurate chub mackerel Scomber japonicus profile, slender fusiform silver body with blue-green dark wavy stripes ONLY on upper back, two separate dorsal fins, small finlets behind rear dorsal and anal fins, deeply forked tail, natural eye and mouth. (2) Child's tricycle three-quarter view: one large front wheel, TWO small rear wheels, pedals and opposite cranks attached DIRECTLY to FRONT WHEEL axle, handlebar fork, seat above frame. No pedals under seat. (3) Main wooden bowl and spoon of white salt crystals; small background vignette of an adult lightly sprinkling salt onto cucumber slices and child tasting cucumber with a small pleased expression, no licking spoon of pure salt. Row2: (4) Accurate horseshoe magnet, one arm red one blue, metallic end faces, few iron paperclips directly touching and hanging from end faces, no lightning sparks or floating unattached clips. (5) Barn swallow perched SIDE VIEW on twig, navy back, red throat, white belly, deeply forked tail, two short legs with fine toes wrapped around branch, three forward toes one rear per foot, fully visible silhouette. (6) Tsubuan sweet red bean paste in bowl, mostly thick dark reddish paste with visible cooked plump small oval adzuki beans some broken skins, not whole enormous spherical cherries; spoon with paste. Row3: (7) Landline telephone on table with handset resting on cradle ABOVE clear 3-column 4-row keypad on telephone body, coiled cord correctly connecting handset to side of base, unobscured buttons. (8) Japanese school wooden vaulting box, trapezoid profile, 5 stackable rectangular wooden sections decreasing in footprint toward top, cream PADDED rectangular top, recessed handholds in side of sections, full box resting on blue gym mat. (9) Dragonfly viewed from directly ABOVE, exactly 4 transparent wings attached to thorax (2 per side), exactly SIX legs attached to thorax visibly splayed (3 each side), long slender red segmented abdomen, large compound eyes, no legs on abdomen. Ensure mechanical and animal accuracy.

Row 1, column 3: A modest knee length party dress hanging on a hanger, one piece bodice and flared skirt.
Row 1, column 4: Three brown acorns with textured cup caps and a small oak leaf.
Row 2, column 1: An empty deep ceramic donburi bowl with a wide mouth and a small foot, interior clearly visible.
Row 2, column 2: A simple blunt table knife with a wooden handle and metal cutting blade, lying flat.
Row 2, column 3: A young green seedling with a few leaves growing from a small soil plug.
Row 2, column 4: A round golden brown Japanese Asian pear, one whole fruit and a wedge revealing white flesh.
Row 3, column 1: Two glossy purple eggplants with green caps.
Row 3, column 2: A small bowl of Japanese natto fermented soybeans with chopsticks lifting sticky strands.
Row 3, column 3: A cluster of yellow rapeseed blossoms on leafy green stems, Japanese nanohana.
Row 3, column 4: A folded cloth dining napkin placed beside a plain white plate.
Row 4, column 1: A metal cooking pot with two handles and a lid set beside it.
Row 4, column 2: A freshwater catfish with broad head long whisker barbels and smooth dark body.
Row 4, column 3: Blue ocean waves curling and breaking with white foam on a simple coast.
Row 4, column 4: A small brown garden slug without any shell, with two long eye stalks, on a damp green leaf.

assets.meaning: 本物に似せて作られたものや、本物ではないもの。
assets.prompt:
Create ONE square 4 by 4 contact sheet, EXACTLY 16 equally sized square illustrations, white straight narrow gutters. Row-major order, four columns and four rows. Warm clear Japanese elementary-school picture-book watercolor style. Every cell is independent and fits entirely inside its square with margin. No captions, titles, numbering or watermarks. Follow each cell scene literally, especially action direction and objects.
Cell 1 (row 1, column 1), 鼻歌: A smiling child softly HUMS while tidying books. Lips are CLOSED, cheeks relaxed, a few soft music-note symbols near the closed mouth. No microphone or wide-open singing mouth. Gentle humming.
Cell 2 (row 1, column 2), 甘塩: A small grilled salmon fillet and a tiny pinch of salt between fingers. Only three tiny grains sprinkled lightly, with a happy child tasting the mild salted fish. NO pile of salt or heap of crystals. Mild and lightly salted food.
Cell 3 (row 1, column 3), 洗いざらい: A child empties every single toy block from a box onto a table. The box is tilted and visibly completely empty. All blocks are now on the table, none left inside. Meaning everything without leaving anything out. NO washing or laundry.
Cell 4 (row 1, column 4), 居座り: A stubborn fully clothed adult remains sitting on a chair with arms folded and feet firmly planted. A host stands beside the open exit door and gestures kindly for the adult to leave; seated adult clearly refuses to move. No comfortable napping.
Cell 5 (row 2, column 1), 一石二鳥: One central action: planting one fruit tree. Two clear result bubbles linked from that one tree: on the left, a basket of apples harvested; on the right, a family resting in its cool shade. One effort produces TWO good benefits. No stone or birds.
Cell 6 (row 2, column 2), 鰻登り: A shop owner is amazed by a sales chart rising very steeply from low left to high right, with coin stacks that rise steeply in the same direction. Shows rapid steep growth. NO eel or waterfall.
Cell 7 (row 2, column 3), オウンゴール: A soccer defender in a BLUE jersey accidentally kicks the ball backward into the goal guarded by their own BLUE-jersey goalkeeper. Both BLUE teammates look dismayed. An opposing RED-jersey player outside the goal celebrates. Clear ball arrow leads from BLUE defender to own goal. No mixed teammate colors.
Cell 8 (row 2, column 4), 行政: A municipal city-hall public-service counter. A civil servant processes a resident's application and hands back an official certificate. Small thought bubbles show public garbage collection and repaired streetlights, representing everyday government services implementing rules. NO parliament debate or legislature building.
Cell 9 (row 3, column 1), 献血: A calm fully clothed ADULT volunteer donates blood at a medical donation center. Nurse assists the arm. Tubing from the covered adult forearm runs DOWN to a collection bag resting on a small scale BELOW the arm, on a low trolley. NO hanging IV bag above the arm, no transfusion flowing into the person, no wound or exposed needle or visible puncture. The collected red liquid stays only inside the sealed bag and tubing.
Cell 10 (row 3, column 2), 後退: Side view of a car pointing RIGHT (headlights and hood on the right, rear tail lights on the left). A big arrow under the car points LEFT, showing reversing backward opposite the car's forward direction. Driver looks back over shoulder. Keep hood/rear and arrow unambiguous.
Cell 11 (row 3, column 3), 後転: A backward gym roll in three small stages within one cell, on a soft mat, same person facing LEFT at start and at end. Stage left: crouching, facing left, feet flat and knees tucked. Middle: rolling BACK toward the RIGHT over a rounded back with knees tucked, feet travel over the head to the right, hands beside ears. Right: finishes crouched facing LEFT again. Never change facing direction. A curved arrow points from start to finish to the RIGHT.

Illustrates making large profits with little effort.
Cell 16 (row 4, column 4), 根強い: Lasting popularity over generations: an elderly grandfather shows a sepia photograph of himself as a young boy happily playing KENDAMA, while his smiling young grandchild beside him plays the SAME traditional kendama now. Create precisely aligned 3 by 3 contact sheet of NINE independent square Japanese children's educational watercolor illustrations. 4 child gently declines another helping of vegetables by politely gesturing a SMALL serving with hands and gentle apologetic face instead of blunt rejection; parent understands, tactful indirect wording illustrated by tiny-serving thought bubble and remaining full plate.
5 diagram on plain white background: central dot, three red arrows starting near dot and radiating straight OUTWARD, arrowheads at outer ends; no circular arrows, NO text, illustrates direction away from center not forces.
6 extension cord connecting wall socket to table lamp far away, clear cable and connected plug/socket fully visible, unplugged shorter cable shown beside for comparison, safe no exposed wire.
7 many children at school festival, varied friendly faces with normal eyes, all entirely within cell, single crowd scene, no stray bottom fragments.
8 before and after shop display for one apple: LEFT price 100 coins represented as ten stacks of ten dots; RIGHT price only 50 coins represented as five stacks of ten dots, large downward arrow and apple in both views, clearly large decrease in price. use concise 100 and 50 numerals if needed.
9 close view two children warmly smiling with natural symmetrical pupils, gentle cute appearance, cheerful happy expressions, no strange eyes, clean simple background.
